listing.title: Prodaja, dvosoban stan, 134m², Budva, Crna Gora
Sale, two bedroom apartment, 134m², Budva, Crna Gora
listing.description:
Predstavljamo vam dvosoban stan povrsine 134.55m2 koji je lociran na 6. spratu kompleksa u izgradnji na prvoj liniji mora u Budvi.
Rok zavrsetka april 2028.
Raspored plaćanja je sledeći:-Rezervacija: 10.000 € (nepovratno)-30% kupoprodajne cene – u roku od 10 dana od potpisivanja Preliminarnog ugovoraPreostali iznos kupci plaćaju u tri rate:Prva rata 30% – nakon završetka konstrukcijeDruga rata 30% – nakon završetka završnih radovaTreća rata 10% – prilikom primopredaje nekretnineOvaj jedinstveni kompleks nalazi se u samom epicentru turističke Budve, na šetalištu, okružen fantastičnim prirodnim uslovima kao što je neopisiv panoramski pogled koji prepliće najbolje od Budvanske rivijere sa modernim objektima, sadržajima i uslugama hotela sa 5 zvjezdica. Stambene jedinice dostupne za prodaju nalaze se od četvrtog do devetog sprata. Ovi pažljivo dizajnirani stanovi pružaju savršen spoj luksuza i funkcionalnosti, sa zadivljujućim pogledom na okolinu. Deseti sprat je isključivo posvećen penthaus apartmanima, koji se mogu pohvaliti raskošnim sadržajima kao što su hidromasažne kade i prostrane terase. Ukupno ima 66 apartmana dostupnih za kupovinu uključujući sobe, apartmane i penthaus apartmaneKompleks poseduje dva ulaza, jedan pogodno lociran na šetalištu, a drugi pristupačan sa bulevara. Glavni ulaz, koji se nalazi u aneksu kongresnog centra, omogućava lak pristup raznim događajima i konferencijama. Sadržaji KompleksaKompleks nudi poslovni prostor, prodavnice i servisni centar, dva restorana i kafić sa pogledom na Jadransko more, spa centar sa bazenima i teretanom, kao i konferencijske sadržaje. Podzemni objekti obuhvataju tehničke prostorije, kao i podzemni parking sa ukupno 160 parking mjesta. Usluge i SigurnostKonsijerž i 24-časovno obezbjeđenje jamče vaš mir i sigurnost. Naša raznolika ponuda hotela s pet zvjezdica i sadržaja Budve pretvara vašu investiciju u luksuzni stil života. Zelena OazaOvaj savremeni objekat također nudi zelenu oazu na krovu konferencijske sale, gdje ćete uživati u prirodi.
Poseban fokus stavljen je na održavanje zelenih površina, koje će vlasnicima i gostima omogućiti sezonsko uživanje u prirodi i lokalnoj flori na kućnom pragu. Pogodnosti-DVA HOTELSKA RESTORANA,KAFIĆ KANCELARIJE I PRODAVNICE NA PRVIM SPRATOVIMA.-SPA CENTAR SA TERETANOM I BAZENIMA ZELENA OAZA NA KROVU BRENDIRANE REZIDENCIJE.-Tehničke prostorije i podzemni parking-Brendirane rezidencije s uslugom održavanja-Paketi namještaja dostupni za useljenje

We present to you a two bedroom apartment with an area of 134.55m2, which is located on the 6nd floor of a complex under construction on the first line of the sea in Budva.
Completion Date: April 2028Payment Schedule:Reservation: €10,000 (non-refundable)30% of the purchase price – within 10 days of signing the Preliminary AgreementThe remaining amount is paid in three installments:First installment 30% – after completion of the structural constructionSecond installment 30% – after completion of the finishing worksThird installment 10% – upon handover of the propertyThis unique complex is located in the very heart of tourist Budva, on the promenade, surrounded by fantastic natural conditions and offering an indescribable panoramic view that combines the best of the Budva Riviera with modern facilities, amenities, and five-star hotel services.
The residential units available for sale are located from the 4th to the 9th floor. These carefully designed apartments provide a perfect blend of luxury and functionality, with stunning views of the surroundings. The 10th floor is exclusively dedicated to penthouse apartments, featuring luxurious amenities such as jacuzzis and spacious terraces.
In total, there are 66 apartments available for purchase, including standard units, apartments, and penthouses.
The complex has two entrances, one conveniently located on the promenade and another accessible from the boulevard. The main entrance, located in the annex of the congress center, provides easy access to various events and conferences.
Complex Amenities:The complex offers commercial spaces, shops, and a service center, two restaurants and a café with a view of the Adriatic Sea, a spa center with pools and a gym, as well as conference facilities. The underground facilities include technical rooms and an underground parking area with a total of 160 parking spaces.
Services and Security:Concierge and 24-hour security ensure peace of mind and safety. The diverse offering of five-star hotels and amenities in Budva turns your investment into a luxurious lifestyle.
Green Oasis:This modern building also features a green oasis on the roof of the conference hall, where residents can enjoy nature. Special attention is given to maintaining green spaces, allowing owners and guests to enjoy seasonal greenery and local flora at their doorstep.
Additional Benefits:Two hotel restaurants, café, offices, and shops on the lower floorsSpa center with gym and pools, green rooftop oasis, branded residencesTechnical rooms and underground parkingBranded residences with maintenance servicesFurniture packages available for move-in

listing.title: Prodaja, jednosoban stan, 87m², Tivat, Crna Gora
Sale, one bedroom apartment, 87m², Tivat, Crna Gora
listing.description:
Nekretnine Crna Gora,Tivat-Predstavljamo vam novi rezidencijalni kompleks koji se nalazi u srcu Porto Montenegra, u kvartu Sinhro grada Tivta. Ovaj projekat nekretnina je magični spoj elegancije, udobnosti i najsavremenijeg dizajna, kreiran da ispuni sva vaša očekivanja i još mnogo toga.
Projekat obuhvata tri stambena bloka i krovni bazen koji povezuje dva odvojena bloka. Svaka zgrada ima luksuzne stanove i prostrane penthause, savršeno projektovane od najkvalitetnijih materijala.
Možete birati između 40 različitih stanova u rasponu od jednosobnih 49m2 do fantastičnih penthouse apartmana od 321m2.
Na prodaju je i 6 poslovnih jedinica.
Usluge i pogodnosti:• Privatni konsijerž• Infiniti bazen na krovu• Privatno obezbeđenje• Podzemna garaža• Namenske skladišne jedinice• Sistem pametne kućeOsnovni paket uključuje elegantan dizajn enterijera, sa mogućnošću izbora između dva stila - italijanskog i nordijskog. Dodatno, na zahtev, svaki stan može biti opremljen i opremljen najkvalitetnijim nameštajem i opremom.
Kompleks se nalazi pored luksuzne marine za mega-jahte Porto Montenegro iu neposrednoj blizini međunarodnih škola i aerodroma u Tivtu, Podgorici i Dubrovniku.
Pored nagrađivane marine, Porto Montenegro se može pohvaliti šarmantnim rezidencijalnim delom, hotelom Regent sa pet zvezdica, luksuznim buticima, prodavnicama, restoranima, sportskim i rekreativnim sadržajima, koji privlače živu međunarodnu zajednicu tokom cele godine.
Ulaganje u sigurnost i prosperitetUlaganjem u projekat obezbeđujete zagarantovan povraćaj uloženih sredstava od 6% godišnje. Ovo je prilika za pametno ulaganje, kombinujući luksuz sa finansijskom sigurnošću.
Dodatno, na zahtjev klijenta, svaki apartman može biti u cjelosti opremljen najkvalitetnijim namještajem i ugradnim elementima. Trenutno postoje 2 posebne ponude:Prilikom potpisivanja kupoprodajnog ugovora pre 1. juna 2025. godine, svaki apartman na poklon dobija parking mesto u podzemnoj garazi i individualnu ostavu.
Pri kupovini rezidencija 106, 108, 113, 403 i 404 - kompletno opremanje i namještaj na poklon!#NekretnineCrnaGora #Tivat #PortoMontenegro #PogledNaMore #Investicija #NovKompleksSaBazenom #LuksuzniStanovi #StanoviUIzgradnji

Exclusive Residential Living in Porto Montenegro, Tivat
Discover an exceptional residential development in the prestigious Synchro district of Porto Montenegro, where modern architecture, timeless elegance and the Mediterranean lifestyle meet in one of the Adriatic’s most desirable locations.
A New Vision of Luxury Living
Designed to combine sophistication, comfort and functionality, the development consists of three residential buildings, with a spectacular rooftop infinity pool connecting two of the buildings. Each residence features carefully selected materials, elegant finishes and contemporary design, creating an exclusive living environment.
Residences Tailored to Your Lifestyle
* 40 luxury apartments, ranging from 49 m² one-bedroom residences to impressive 321 m² penthouses * 6 commercial units available for purchase * Two refined interior design concepts: Italian and Nordic * Optional bespoke furnishing and complete interior fit-out
Whether you are seeking an elegant waterfront home, a holiday residence or a premium real estate investment, the development offers a range of options to suit different lifestyles and preferences.
Exceptional Amenities and Services
Residents can enjoy a range of premium facilities designed to enhance everyday comfort and convenience:
* Private concierge service * Rooftop infinity swimming pool * 24/7 private security * Underground parking garage * Private storage units * Smart home technology
Every detail is designed to provide a seamless residential experience in an exclusive setting.
An Outstanding Location
Located just moments from the renowned Porto Montenegro superyacht marina, the development places residents at the centre of Tivat’s vibrant waterfront lifestyle.
Luxury boutiques, fine dining restaurants, the five-star Regent Hotel, sports and recreational facilities, and international schools are all within easy reach.
Tivat International Airport is just a short drive away, while Podgorica and Dubrovnik airports provide additional international travel connections.
A Prestigious Address with Investment Potential
Porto Montenegro is one of the Adriatic’s most sought-after luxury destinations, combining a world-class marina, elegant waterfront residences and a vibrant international community throughout the year.
The project has been promoted with an annual return on investment of 6%. Prospective investors should confirm the current terms and request details of any contractual guarantees, conditions and associated risks before making an investment decision.
Exclusive Purchase Opportunities
Special purchase incentives may be available, subject to current availability and the developer’s terms.
Previous promotional offers included underground parking and private storage, as well as complimentary furnishing and interior decoration for selected residences. These offers were subject to specific deadlines and conditions, so their current availability should be confirmed directly with the sales team.
Discover Your Place in Porto Montenegro
Whether you are looking for a prestigious residence on the Adriatic coast, an elegant holiday home or a property with investment potential, this development offers the opportunity to experience contemporary luxury living in the heart of Tivat.
Contact us for the latest availability, apartment layouts, prices and detailed investment information.

Luxury Real Estate in Porto Montenegro, Tivat
Discover an exclusive residential development in the prestigious Synchro district of Porto Montenegro, where contemporary architecture, sophisticated design and Mediterranean living come together in an exceptional waterfront setting.
Contemporary Design Meets Refined Elegance
The development comprises three residential buildings, with a spectacular rooftop swimming pool connecting two of the blocks. Each residence is thoughtfully designed using premium materials, elegant finishes and modern architectural elements to create a refined and comfortable living environment.

Na prodaju ekskluzivan duplex apartman ukupne površine 119 m², smešten u luksuznom boutique kompleksu The Cube u Krašićima, na poluostrvu Luštica. Ova moderna nekretnina pruža savršen spoj savremenog dizajna, privatnosti i vrhunskog kvaliteta života, uz spektakularan panoramski pogled na more i planine.
Kompleks se nalazi u mirnom delu Krašića i predstavlja jedinstvenu privatnu celinu sa svega 9 apartmana i 2 luksuzne vile, čime se obezbeđuje visok nivo komfora i ekskluzivnosti. Smešten je na odličnoj lokaciji, oko 15 minuta vožnje od Aerodroma Tivat i nekoliko minuta od prestižnog kompleksa Luštica Bay.
Apartman se prostire na dve etaže. Na prvom nivou nalazi se prostrani dnevni boravak sa kuhinjom i trpezarijom, gostinski toalet i izlaz na veliku terasu sa otvorenim panoramskim pogledom. Na drugom nivou smeštene su dve komforne spavaće sobe, pri čemu svaka soba poseduje svoje privatno kupatilo, pružajući dodatnu udobnost i privatnost. Na ovoj etaži se nalazi i tehnička prostorija sa veš mašinom, bojlerom i dodatnim prostorom za odlaganje.
Apartman je završen i spreman za useljenje. Projektovan je sa velikim staklenim površinama koje omogućavaju obilje prirodne svetlosti i nesmetan pogled na Jadransko more i okolne planine.
Stanari kompleksa imaju na raspolaganju zajednički bazen dužine 20 metara koji se održava tokom cele godine, kao i dve uređene lounge zone za odmor. Posebna prednost kompleksa je što vile imaju sopstvene bazene i garažna mesta, dok glavni bazen koriste isključivo vlasnici apartmana, što dodatno doprinosi privatnosti.
Nekretnina poseduje kompletnu dokumentaciju. Garažno parking mesto dostupno je uz doplatu.

Exclusive Duplex Apartment for Sale in Krašići, Luštica Peninsula
Discover an exceptional duplex apartment in an exclusive boutique residential complex in Krašići on the Luštica Peninsula. Offering 119 m² of living space, this contemporary residence combines elegant design, privacy and Mediterranean charm, complemented by breathtaking panoramic views of the Adriatic Sea and surrounding mountains.

Situated in a peaceful and picturesque setting, the complex comprises just nine apartments and two luxury villas, offering residents a private and tranquil living environment.
The property enjoys an excellent location, approximately 15 minutes by car from Tivat International Airport and just a short drive from the prestigious Luštica Bay development.
Contemporary Living Across Two Levels
The apartment is arranged over two floors, with a thoughtfully designed layout that maximises comfort, functionality and natural light.
Ground Floor
* Spacious open-plan living area * Modern kitchen and dining area * Guest toilet * Large terrace with panoramic sea and mountain views
Upper Floor
* Two comfortable bedrooms, each with its own en-suite bathroom * Dedicated utility room with a washing machine, boiler and additional storage space
Large glass surfaces fill the interiors with natural light, creating a bright and inviting atmosphere while framing the spectacular Adriatic scenery.
Exclusive Amenities and Privacy
Residents enjoy access to a 20-metre swimming pool, maintained throughout the year, as well as two furnished relaxation areas designed for outdoor leisure.
The complex offers a particularly attractive level of privacy: the villas feature their own private swimming pools and garage spaces, while the main swimming pool is reserved exclusively for apartment owners.
Ready to Move In
The apartment is fully completed and ready for immediate occupancy, making it an excellent choice as a permanent residence, a holiday home or a real estate investment on Montenegro’s Adriatic coast.
The property has complete documentation, and a garage parking space is available for purchase at an additional cost.
A rare opportunity to own an elegant duplex residence in an exclusive boutique development, surrounded by natural beauty and offering spectacular panoramic views of the Adriatic Sea.

The plot is well-connected with infrastructure and is located near the new "City Quarter" neighborhood, "Delta City" and "City Mall" shopping centers, and the University of Montenegro.
This location offers an excellent opportunity for the development of residential and commercial properties. It is ideal for investors looking to take advantage of the growth and development potential in this part of Podgorica.

U Krašićima, opština Tivat, na prvoj liniji do mora, nalazi se plac od 506 m² sa dozvolom za izgradnju vile površine 350 m². Već je izgrađen prvi sprat, a prema projektu planiran je mini-hotel sa šest apartmana, uz mogućnost prilagođavanja u porodičnu kuću.
Imanje raspolaže i privatnim betonskim pristaništem od 160 m². Projekat je odobren, komunalije su plaćene, izvedeni su iskopi, podrum i potporni zidovi. Struja, voda i kanalizacija su dovedeni do placa. Lokacija je mirna, sa restoranima i prodavnicama na pješačkoj udaljenosti.

In Krašići, municipality of Tivat, on the first line to the sea, there is a land plot of 506 m² with a permit for the construction of a villa of 350 m². The first floor has already been built, and according to the project, a mini-hotel with six apartments is planned, with the possibility of adapting it into a family house.
The property also has a private concrete pier of 160 m². The project is approved, utilities are paid, excavations, a basement and retaining walls have been carried out. Electricity, water and sewerage have been brought to the land plot. The location is quiet, with restaurants and shops within walking distance.

Prodaje se trosoban stan površine 172,61 m² sa pogledom na more i grad, koji je lociran na 8. spratu kompleksa u izgradnji na prvoj liniji mora u Budvi.

Stambene jedinice dostupne za prodaju nalaze se od četvrtog do devetog sprata. Ovi pažljivo projektovani stanovi pružaju savršen spoj luksuza i funkcionalnosti, sa zadivljujućim pogledom na okolinu. Kompleks poseduje dva ulaza – jedan je pogodno lociran na šetalištu, a drugi je dostupan sa bulevara. Glavni ulaz, smešten u aneksu kongresnog centra, omogućava lak pristup raznim događajima i konferencijama.

listing.title: Prodaja, kuća, 223m², Reževići, Budva
Sale, house, 223m², Reževići, Budva
listing.description:
Na prodaju je luksuzna townhouse vila površine 223 m² sa privatnom parcelom od 306 m² i bazenom, smeštena u prestižnom i mirnom delu Budvanske rivijere – Reževićima. Vila se prostire na tri sprata i potkrovlje i obuhvata četiri spavaće sobe, cetiri kupatila, dva prostrana dnevna boravka i dve kuhinje. Panoramski prozori od 2,5 m i visoki plafoni od 3 m stvaraju osećaj prostranosti i obilja prirodne svetlosti, dok dve terase nude nezaboravan pogled na Jadransko more. Na parceli se nalazi privatni bazen, uređeno i ozelenjeno dvorište, kao i parking prostor za dva automobila.
Kupovina ove nekretnine donosi posebne pogodnosti – mogućnost odloženog plaćanja (30% prilikom kupovine, a ostatak u roku od godinu dana), kao i oslobađanje od poreza na prenos vlasništva (3%). Takođe, vlasnici ostvaruju pravo na boravišnu dozvolu u Crnoj Gori.
Ono što ovu nekretninu čini posebnom jeste kombinacija vrhunskog kvaliteta gradnje i savremene opreme. Enterijer krase prirodni kamen, keramika premium klase i moderna stolarija, dok je kuhinja ugrađena i kompletno opremljena. Vila poseduje smart home sistem, optički internet, video nadzor, alarmni sistem, centralni bojler, rezervoar za vodu i bio-septički sistem. Dvorište ima automatizovan sistem za navodnjavanje kojim se upravlja online.
Lokacija nudi savršen balans mira i povezanosti – vila je deo zatvorenog, ograđenog kompleksa u prirodnom okruženju, a istovremeno se nalazi svega 10 minuta vožnje od Budve, 5 minuta od Svetog Stefana, 30 minuta od Kotora, Porto Montenegra i Luštica Bay-a, te 50 minuta od aerodroma u Tivtu i Podgorici. Plaže sa kristalno čistim morem su u neposrednoj blizini, a za ljubitelje zime skijališta su udaljena oko dva sata vožnje. Ova vila predstavlja jedinstvenu priliku za luksuzan porodični život, ali i za unosnu investiciju zahvaljujući velikom potencijalu za izdavanje. Dostupna je kompletna profesionalna usluga održavanja i menadžmenta rentiranja, što omogućava stabilan pasivan prihod.

For sale is a luxury townhouse villa with an area of 223 m² with a private plot of 306 m² and a swimming pool, located in the prestigious and peaceful part of the Budva Riviera — Reževići.
The villa spreads over three floors and an attic and includes four bedrooms, four bathrooms, two spacious living areas and two kitchens.
Panoramic windows of 2.5 m and high ceilings of 3 m create a feeling of space and plenty of natural light, while two terraces offer a breathtaking view of the Adriatic Sea. The plot features a private swimming pool, a landscaped and green courtyard, as well as parking space for two cars.
Buying this property brings special benefits — the possibility of deferred payment (30% at the time of purchase, the rest within a year), as well as exemption from the property transfer tax (3%). Also, the owners receive a right to a residence permit in Montenegro.
What makes this property special is the combination of high-quality construction and modern equipment. The interior is decorated with natural stone, premium ceramics and modern carpentry, while the kitchen is built-in and fully equipped.
The villa has a smart home system, optical internet, video surveillance, an alarm system, a central boiler, a water tank and a bio-septic system. The courtyard has an automated irrigation system that is controlled online.
The location offers a perfect balance of peace and connectivity — the villa is part of a closed, fenced complex in a natural environment, and at the same time is only 10 minutes by car from Budva, 5 minutes from Sveti Stefan, 30 minutes from Kotor, Porto Montenegro and Luštica Bay, and 50 minutes from the airport in Tivat and Podgorica. Beaches with crystal clear water are in close proximity, and ski resorts are about two hours away by car.
This villa represents a unique opportunity for a luxurious family life, but also for an attractive investment thanks to its great potential for rental.

Na prodaju porodično imanje u Valjevskoj Loznici, nadomak Valjeva. Imanje obuhvata 3 hektara(30 000m2) plodne zemlje, šumu, podignute šljivike, kao i stambeni objekat površine 180 m² uz dodatnih 100 m² pomoćnih objekata (uključujući pečenjaru).
Kuća ima 4 spavaće sobe, jedno kupatilo i obezbijeđen parking za četiri vozila. Imanje izlazi na seosku rječicu i posjeduje sopstveni bunar, a dostupni su i gradski vodovod, rasvjeta i dobra putna povezanost. Udaljeno je svega par minuta od magistrale i lokalne pruge, 7–8 minuta vožnje od centra Valjeva i oko 30 minuta od Beograda. Lokacija je mirna, okružena prirodom, u blizini više banja (Vrujci), idealna za život, odmor ili razvoj seoskog turizma. Može zamjena za Cg, primorje i Pg.
067/231-153

For sale, a family estate in Valjevska Loznica, near Valjevo. The estate includes 3 hectares (30,000m2) of fertile land, a forest, established plum orchards, as well as a residential building of 180 m² with an additional 100 m² of auxiliary buildings (including a barbecue house).
The house has 4 bedrooms, one bathroom, and secured parking for four vehicles. The estate borders a rural stream and has its own well, and city water supply, lighting, and good road connectivity are available. It is just a few minutes from the main road and local railway, 7–8 minutes drive from the center of Valjevo, and about 30 minutes from Beograd. The location is peaceful, surrounded by nature, near several spas (Vrujci), ideal for living, vacation, or the development of rural tourism. Exchange possible for Cg, the coast, and Pg.

The enjoyment of life is further enriched by carefully landscaped gardens, swimming pools, and the immediate proximity to Portonovi's amenities, from the marina to exclusive restaurants and spa centers.
With prices from €1,350,000 to €1,400,000, the two-bedroom apartments at Village Residences represent a rare opportunity to become a homeowner in the heart of one of the most desirable destinations in the Mediterranean – an address that combines luxury, style, and timeless value.

Basement: 102,23 m²

Contracted fee: 7.848,25 €

listing.title: Prodaja, jednosoban stan, 58m², Bečići, Budva
Sale, one bedroom apartment, 58m², Bečići, Budva
listing.description:
Prodaja jednosobnog stana 58 m² sa pogledom na more u ekskluzivnom stambenom kompleksu u Rafailovićima – prvi red do mora sa privatnom plažom i luksuznim sadržajimaPredstavljamo vam jedinstvenu priliku za kupovinu luksuznog stana direktno na bečićkoj plaži. Smješten na prvoj liniji mora, samo 10 metara od čuvene plaže koja važi za jednu od najlepših na Jadranu, ovaj moderan stambeni kompleks u izgradnji kombinuje vrhunski dizajn, ekskluzivne sadržaje i privatnu plažu, nudeći nezaboravno iskustvo života na moru. Stanari imaju ekskluzivan privatni pristup plaži ispred objekta, a u blizini se nalaze restorani, kafići, barovi i butici koji čine život praktičnim i zabavnim.
Kompleks nudi luksuzne sadržaje za opuštanje i zabavu, uključujući zatvoreni i otvoreni bazen sa panoramskim pogledom na Jadransko more, moderno opremljen fitness centar, kazino na dva nivoa, potpuno opremljen wellness i spa centar, kao i maloprodajne prostore sa restoranima, kafićima, barovima i buticima.
Projektom je predviđena stambena zgrada od 12 spratova sa ukupno 136 stambenih jedinica i 95 parking mesta, dizajnirana da zadovolji najviše standarde udobnosti, privatnosti i luksuznog života na obali. Svi stanovi dolaze potpuno namješteni, opremljeni prozorima sa dvostrukim staklom za poboljšanu termo i zvučnu izolaciju, a koriste se samo najkvalitetniji materijali koji osiguravaju izuzetnu izdržljivost i komfor.
Stanovi su različitih rasporeda i veličina: od studija od 38 m², jednosobnih stanova od 53–69 m², dvosobnih od 84–113 m², do trosobnih stanova od 161–170 m². Cene se kreću od 269.000 € do 1.450.000 €, što definiše cenu po kvadratnom metru od 4.700 € do 8.500 €, u zavisnosti od tipa stana, sprata i rasporeda. Mesečna naknada za održavanje iznosi 6,90 € / m².
Atraktivan model plaćanja predviđa 10% prilikom rezervacije, 60% tokom izgradnje sa završetkom u decembru 2026. godine, dok se preostali iznos od 30% plaća u maju 2027. godine, a predaja stanova je planirana u periodu mart–april 2027. Grand Opening kompleksa predviđen je za leto 2027. godine.
Pored toga, postoji i atraktivan model podjele profita sa profesionalnim upravljanjem i visoko očekivanim stepenom popunjenosti – 70% za vlasnika i 30% za menadžment, što čini ovu nekretninu idealnom kako za život, tako i za investiciju.
Ovo je jedinstvena prilika za luksuzan život ili investiciju na najlepšoj plaži Budvanske rivijere, sa ekskluzivnim sadržajima, privatnom plažom i panoramskim pogledom na more.

Luxury One-Bedroom Apartment with Sea View in Rafailovići, Montenegro
58 m² | First Line to the Sea | Private Beach | Premium Amenities | Investment Opportunity
Discover an exceptional opportunity to own a luxury one-bedroom apartment in an exclusive residential complex located directly on the stunning Bečići Riviera, in Rafailovići, Montenegro.
Situated just 10 metres from one of the Adriatic coast’s most beautiful beaches, this prestigious development combines contemporary architecture, elegant interiors, premium facilities, and breathtaking sea views. Designed for those who appreciate sophisticated coastal living, the complex offers an exclusive lifestyle with direct access to a private beach area.
Property Highlights
* Apartment size: 58 m² * Layout: One bedroom, living room, kitchen, and bathroom * View: Panoramic Adriatic Sea views * Location: First line to the sea, Rafailovići, Budva Riviera * Furnishing: Fully furnished to a high standard * Beach access: Exclusive private beach area * Status: Under construction
Exclusive Residential Amenities
Residents will enjoy an impressive selection of premium facilities designed to provide comfort, relaxation, and entertainment, including:
* Indoor and outdoor swimming pools with panoramic sea views * A modern, fully equipped fitness centre * A luxury wellness and spa centre * A two-level casino * Restaurants, cafés, bars, and boutiques within the complex * High-quality construction materials and double-glazed windows for enhanced thermal and acoustic insulation
The development comprises a modern 12-storey residential building with 136 apartments and 95 parking spaces, offering an exclusive environment for both permanent residence and holiday living.
An Attractive Investment Opportunity
In addition to its exceptional location and lifestyle benefits, this property offers significant potential as a holiday rental investment.
A professional property management model is planned, with a proposed revenue-sharing arrangement of 70% to the owner and 30% to the management company, subject to the final management agreement.
Its beachfront location, premium amenities, and appeal to international visitors make this apartment an attractive option for investors seeking rental income and long-term capital appreciation.
Payment Plan and Completion
The proposed payment schedule is structured as follows:
* 10% upon reservation * 60% during construction * 30% in May 2027
Construction completion is scheduled for December 2026, with apartment handover planned for March–April 2027. The grand opening is anticipated for summer 2027.
All construction and handover dates are subject to confirmation by the developer.
A Premium Address on the Adriatic
Whether you are looking for a luxury seaside residence, an exclusive holiday home, or an investment property in one of Montenegro’s most desirable coastal destinations, this 58 m² apartment represents an opportunity to enjoy the best of the Budva Riviera.
Experience the perfect combination of sea views, beachfront living, premium amenities, and investment potential in the heart of Rafailovići.
Contact us today for pricing, availability, floor plans, and further information.

Luxury One-Bedroom Apartment for Sale – 56 m² in Rafailovići, Montenegro
Prime Beachfront Location | Private Beach Access | Luxury Amenities | Investment Potential
Discover an exceptional opportunity to own a luxury one-bedroom apartment in an exclusive residential complex in Rafailovići, on the stunning Budva Riviera in Montenegro.
Located on the first line to the sea, just 10 metres from the beautiful Bečići Beach, this prestigious development combines contemporary architecture, elegant interiors, premium amenities, and an outstanding coastal location. Designed for those who appreciate refined seaside living, the complex offers an exclusive lifestyle with private beach access and breathtaking views of the Adriatic.
Property Highlights
* Apartment size: 56 m² * Layout: One bedroom, living area, kitchen, and bathroom * Location: Rafailovići, Budva Riviera, Montenegro * Beach proximity: Approximately 10 metres from Bečići Beach * Furnishing: Fully furnished * Beach access: Exclusive access to the private beach area * Building status: Under construction
Premium Amenities and Facilities
The residential complex is designed to provide residents with a luxurious lifestyle, offering an impressive range of facilities, including:
* Indoor and outdoor swimming pools with panoramic Adriatic Sea views * A modern, fully equipped fitness centre * A dedicated wellness and spa centre * A two-level casino * On-site restaurants, cafés, bars, and boutiques * High-quality construction materials and double-glazed windows for improved thermal and sound insulation
The development comprises a modern 12-storey building with 136 residential units and 95 parking spaces, combining contemporary design, comfort, and functionality in a sought-after beachfront setting.
Property Prices and Maintenance
The development offers a range of apartment types to suit different lifestyle preferences and investment goals:
* Studios: 38 m² * One-bedroom apartments: 53–69 m² * Two-bedroom apartments: 84–113 m² * Three-bedroom apartments: 161–170 m²
Prices across the development range from €269,000 to €1,450,000, depending on the apartment type, floor, layout, and views. The indicative price per square metre ranges from €4,700 to €8,500.
Monthly maintenance fee: €6.90 per m².
Please contact us for the current asking price and availability of this 56 m² apartment.
Flexible Payment Plan
The proposed payment schedule is structured as follows:
* 10% upon reservation * 60% during construction * 30% in May 2027
Construction completion is scheduled for December 2026, with apartment handover planned for March–April 2027. The grand opening is anticipated for summer 2027.
All dates and payment terms are subject to confirmation by the developer.
Investment Opportunity with Professional Management
In addition to offering an exceptional seaside lifestyle, this property presents an attractive opportunity for holiday rental investment.
A proposed revenue-sharing model allocates 70% of rental revenue to the owner and 30% to the management company, subject to the final management agreement.
The beachfront location, premium amenities, and appeal to international holidaymakers provide a strong foundation for rental potential. Actual occupancy, operating costs, and returns will depend on market conditions and the final management arrangements.
An Exclusive Lifestyle on the Budva Riviera
Whether you are seeking a luxury holiday home, a permanent seaside residence, or an investment property in one of Montenegro’s most desirable coastal destinations, this 56 m² apartment offers an opportunity to experience the best of Adriatic living.
Enjoy the convenience of beachfront access, the comfort of modern residential facilities, and the vibrant atmosphere of Rafailovići, with restaurants, cafés, bars, and boutiques nearby.
Contact us today for the asking price, floor plan, availability, and further details about this exclusive beachfront property.

Kompleks nudi luksuzne sadržaje za opuštanje i zabavu, uključujući zatvoreni i otvoreni bazen sa panoramskim pogledom na Jadransko more, moderno opremljen fitness centar, kazino na dva nivoa, potpuno opremljen wellness i spa centar, kao i maloprodajne prostore sa restoranima, kafićima, barovima i buticima.
Projektom je predviđena stambena zgrada od 12 spratova sa ukupno 136 stambenih jedinica i 95 parking mesta, dizajnirana da zadovolji najviše standarde udobnosti, privatnosti i luksuznog života na obali. Svi stanovi dolaze potpuno namješteni, opremljeni prozorima sa dvostrukim staklom za poboljšanu termo i zvučnu izolaciju, a koriste se samo najkvalitetniji materijali koji osiguravaju izuzetnu izdržljivost i komfor.
Stanovi su različitih rasporeda i veličina: od studija od 38 m², jednosobnih stanova od 53–69 m², dvosobnih od 84–113 m², do trosobnih stanova od 161–170 m². Cene se kreću od 269.000 € do 1.450.000 €, što definiše cenu po kvadratnom metru od 4.700 € do 8.500 €, u zavisnosti od tipa stana, sprata i rasporeda. Pored toga, postoji i atraktivan model podjele profita sa profesionalnim upravljanjem i visoko očekivanim stepenom popunjenosti – 70% za vlasnika i 30% za menadžment, što čini ovu nekretninu idealnom kako za život, tako i za investiciju.
Ovo je jedinstvena prilika za luksuzan život ili investiciju na najlepšoj plaži Budvanske rivijere, sa ekskluzivnim sadržajima, privatnom plažom i panoramskim pogledom na more.

Arhitektonsko oblikovanje nadahnuto je lokalnom vernakularnom arhitekturom, sa fasadom obloženom drvenim letvama i dekorativnim mrežama, koje daju prirodan i autentičan karakter objektu.

The building is positioned on terrain with a pronounced slope, which directly influenced its form and functional organization. The architectural design is inspired by local vernacular architecture, with a facade clad in wooden slats and decorative meshes, which give the building a natural and authentic character.
The complex would comprise 268 apartment units — including studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments — as well as a restaurant with a kitchen, bar, and terrace, a spa zone, and a pool atrium with carefully landscaped ground-level areas, cascading retaining walls and planters.

listing.description:
Objekat u izgradnji pozicioniran u samom srcu Kolašina, okružen mnoštvom kafea, restorana, parkova i igrališta. U neposrednoj blizini nalaze se i pošta, dom zdravlja, supermarketi, autobuska stanica i ostali sadržaji koji u mnogome doprinose ugodnom boravku turista kao i svakodnevnim životnim potrebama. Posebna pažnja posvećena je odabiru modernih i kvalitetnih materijala koji su u kombinaciji sa tradicionalnim principima gradnje karakterističnim za ovo podneblje. U skladu sa tim, završna fasadna obloga su u jednom delu talpe od termotretiranog drveta dok je preostali deo fasade prirodni kamen debljine od 5-8cm. U delu koji se obradjuje termotretiranim drvetom, preko zidova od 20cm se postavlja termoizolacioni sloj debljine 15cm preko čega se predvidja sloj za provetravanje od 5cm i kao završni sloj pomenuto termotretirano drvo montrirano na za to predvidjenu podkonstrukciju. Zidovi čiji je finalni sloj kamen su takodje debljine 20cm i sa spoljašnjem delu se preko zida izradjuje sloj betonskog platna.Podovi na svim terasama se oblažu protivkliznom keramikom i izoluju adekvatnom hidroizolacijom.

- jednosobni stanovi od 44-45-46m2
- dvosobni stanovi od 70m2 i 90m2
- poslovni prostor od 234m2
Kraj radova jun 2027. Cijena iznosi od 2500-2600€/m2.

The property under construction is located in the very heart of Kolašin, surrounded by numerous cafes, restaurants, parks, and playgrounds. In the immediate vicinity are also a post office, health center, supermarkets, bus station, and other amenities that greatly contribute to a pleasant stay for tourists as well as daily life needs. Special attention has been paid to the selection of modern and high-quality materials that are combined with traditional construction principles characteristic of this region. Accordingly, the final facade cladding in one part consists of thermally treated wood panels, while the remaining part of the facade is natural stone with a thickness of 5-8cm. In the section processed with thermally treated wood, a 15cm thick thermal insulation layer is installed over the 20cm walls, followed by a 5cm ventilation layer, and as the final layer, the aforementioned thermally treated wood mounted on the designated substructure. Walls whose final layer is stone are also 20cm thick, and on the exterior part, a layer of concrete canvas is applied over the wall. Floors on all terraces are covered with anti-slip ceramics and insulated with adequate waterproofing.
Available properties within the complex:

- two-bedroom apartments from 70m2 and 90m2
- commercial space of 234m2
Completion of works June 2027. Price ranges from 2500-2600€/m2.

A luxury townhouse villa of 220 m² with a private plot of 265 m² and a swimming pool is up for sale. It is located in the prestigious and peaceful part of the Budva Riviera — Reževići.
The villa spreads over three floors and an attic and includes five bedrooms, five bathrooms, two spacious living areas and two kitchens.
Panoramic windows of 2.5 m and high ceilings of 3 m create a feeling of spaciousness and plenty of natural light, while two terraces offer a memorable view of the Adriatic Sea.
There is a private swimming pool, a landscaped and green courtyard on the plot, as well as parking space for two cars.
Buying this property has special advantages — the option of deferred payment (30% at the time of purchase, the rest within a year), as well as exemption from property transfer tax (3%). Also, the owners receive a residence permit in Montenegro.
What makes this property special is the combination of top-quality construction and modern equipment. The interior is decorated with natural stone, premium ceramics and modern carpentry, while the kitchen is built-in and fully equipped.
The villa has a smart home system, optical internet, video surveillance, an alarm system, a central boiler, a water tank and a bio-septic system. The courtyard has an automated irrigation system that is controlled online.
The location offers a perfect balance of peace and connectivity — the villa is part of a closed, fenced complex in a natural environment, and at the same time it is only 10 minutes by car from Budva, 5 minutes from Sveti Stefan, 30 minutes from Kotor, Porto Montenegro and Luštica Bay, and 50 minutes from the airport in Tivat and Podgorica.
Beaches with crystal clear water are in close proximity, and ski resorts are about two hours away by car.
This villa is a unique opportunity for a luxurious family life, but also for an attractive investment thanks to its great potential for renting out.

listing.title: Prodaja, trosoban stan, 313m², Budva, Crna Gora
Sale, three bedroom apartment, 313m², Budva, Crna Gora
listing.description:
Prodaja luksuznog troetažnog stana 313m² sa garažnim mestom – BudvaNa prodaju je jedna od najluksuznijih i unikatnih nekretnina na teritoriji Budve. Stan ima ukupnu površinu od 313m² i prostire se na tri nivoa modernog objekta, pružajući vrhunski komfor, privatnost i ekskluzivan način života.
Prvi nivo čini prostrani dnevni boravak sa kaminom i trpezarijom, savršeno osmišljen za opuštanje i prijem gostiju. Iz ovog prostora stepenicama, ali i privatnim liftom, može se pristupiti višim nivoima stana.
Na drugom nivou nalazi se prelepa i prostrana spavaća soba sa sopstvenim đakuzijem, saunom i kupatilom, što stanu daje karakter pravog privatnog spa prostora.
Treći nivo namenjen je rekreaciji i poseduje potpuno opremljenu teretanu sa sopstvenim kupatilom, pružajući maksimalnu udobnost i mogućnost treninga u privatnosti doma.
Stan poseduje i prostranu terasu sa pogledom na grad, idealnu za uživanje i odmor.
U cenu stana uključeno je i garažno parking mesto u istoj zgradi, dok lift iz garaže vodi direktno u stan, što dodatno doprinosi ekskluzivnosti i komforu.
Nekretnina je opremljena naprednim sistemom pametne kuće, koji omogućava potpunu kontrolu nad svim funkcijama stana. Ugrađeni su alarmni sistemi (protivpožarni alarm i alarm protiv poplave), meteorološka stanica, kao i ozonski sistem ozvučenja. Posebnu atmosferu u stanu stvara kamin sa eteričnim uljima, dok sistem omogućava upravljanje osvetljenjem i zavesama.
Stan poseduje centralni bojler, centralni usisivač, lift unutar stana, dodatni usisivač u garaži, kao i centralno solarno grejanje, što obezbeđuje vrhunski nivo komfora i energetske efikasnosti.
Ova jedinstvena nekretnina predstavlja savršenu kombinaciju luksuza, savremene tehnologije i prestižne lokacije, namenjenu kupcima koji traže nešto zaista posebno na Budvanskoj rivijeri.

Sale of a luxury three-storey apartment of 313m² with a garage space — BudvaOne of the most luxurious and unique properties in the territory of Budva is up for sale. The apartment has a total area of 313m² and spreads over three floors of a modern building, providing top comfort, privacy and an exclusive lifestyle.
The first floor is a spacious day area with a fireplace and a pantry, perfect for relaxation and entertaining guests. From this space, you can access the higher floors of the apartment using stairs or a private lift.
On the second floor, there is a beautiful and spacious bedroom with its own jacuzzi, sauna and bathroom, giving the apartment the character of a true private spa space.
The third floor is designed for recreation and has a fully equipped gym with its own bathroom, providing maximum convenience and the opportunity to train in the privacy of home.
The apartment also has a spacious terrace with a view of the city, ideal for enjoying and relaxing.
The price of the apartment includes a garage parking space in the same building, while the lift from the garage leads directly to the apartment, which further contributes to the exclusivity and comfort.
The property is equipped with an advanced smart home system, which allows complete control over all functions of the apartment. Alarm systems (fire alarm and flood alarm), a weather station, as well as an ozone sound system are installed. A fireplace with essential oils creates a special atmosphere in the apartment, while the system allows you to control lighting and curtains.
The apartment has a central boiler, a central vacuum cleaner, a lift inside the apartment, an additional vacuum cleaner in the garage, as well as central solar heating, which ensures a top level of comfort and energy efficiency.
This unique property represents a perfect combination of luxury, modern technology and a prestigious location, aimed at buyers looking for something truly special on the Budva Riviera.

listing.description: Objekat u izgradnji pozicioniran u samom srcu Kolašina, okružen mnoštvom kafea, restorana, parkova i igrališta. U neposrednoj blizini nalaze se i pošta, dom zdravlja, supermarketi, autobuska stanica i ostali sadržaji koji u mnogome doprinose ugodnom boravku turista kao i svakodnevnim životnim potrebama. Posebna pažnja posvećena je odabiru modernih i kvalitetnih materijala koji su u kombinaciji sa tradicionalnim principima gradnje karakterističnim za ovo podneblje. U skladu sa tim, završna fasadna obloga su u jednom delu talpe od termotretiranog drveta dok je preostali deo fasade prirodni kamen debljine od 5-8cm. U delu koji se obradjuje termotretiranim drvetom, preko zidova od 20cm se postavlja termoizolacioni sloj debljine 15cm preko čega se predvidja sloj za provetravanje od 5cm i kao završni sloj pomenuto termotretirano drvo montrirano na za to predvidjenu podkonstrukciju. Zidovi čiji je finalni sloj kamen su takodje debljine 20cm i sa spoljašnjem delu se preko zida izradjuje sloj betonskog platna.Podovi na svim terasama se oblažu protivkliznom keramikom i izoluju adekvatnom hidroizolacijom. Dostupne nekretnine u sklopu kompleksa: - jednosobni stanovi od 44-45-46m2 - dvosobni stanovi od 70m2 i 90m2 - poslovni prostor od 234m2 Cijena iznosi od 2500-2600€/m2.

Property under construction located in the very heart of Kolašin, surrounded by many cafes, restaurants, parks, and playgrounds. In the immediate vicinity there are also a post office, health center, supermarkets, bus station, and other amenities which greatly contribute to a pleasant stay for tourists as well as daily life needs. Special attention has been paid to the selection of modern and quality materials which are combined with traditional construction principles characteristic of this region. Accordingly, the final facade cladding in one part consists of thermally treated wood panels, while the remaining part of the facade is natural stone with a thickness of 5-8cm. In the part treated with thermally treated wood, a 15cm thick thermal insulation layer is installed over the 20cm walls, over which a 5cm ventilation layer is provided, and as a final layer, the aforementioned thermally treated wood is mounted on its designated substructure. Walls whose final layer is stone are also 20cm thick, and on the exterior part, a layer of concrete canvas is applied over the wall. Floors on all terraces are covered with non-slip ceramic tiles and insulated with adequate waterproofing. Available properties within the complex: - one-bedroom apartments from 44-45-46m2 - two-bedroom apartments from 70m2 and 90m2 - commercial space of 234m2 The price ranges from 2500-2600€/m2.

listing.title: Prodaja, ugostiteljski objekat, 20995m², Luštica, Herceg Novi
Sale, hospitality venue, 20995m², Luštica, Herceg Novi
listing.description:
Prodaja zemljišta sa projektom hotela sa 5 zvezdica.
Zemljište se nalazi na crnogorskom poluostrvu Luštica, u najvećem zalivu na Jadranskom moru - na obali Boko Kotorskog zaliva, koji se naziva najjužnijim fjordom u Evropi, 10 minuta od tivatskog aerodroma.
Poslednji plac na samoj obali mora gde je još uvek moguće izgraditi hotel sa 5 zvezdica. Priroda ovde je luksuzna. Veličanstvene planine, azurno more. Usamljene uvale sa sitnim peščanim i šljunčanim plažama su raštrkane duž obale, a u okolini se nalaze borovi i maslinjaci, autentična sela, privatna imanja i vinogradi. Jednom rečju, idila.
Postavljeni su temelji za izgradnju područja Golf Residences. Svetski poznati igrač Geri Plejer je pozvan da razvije projekat golf terena. Ovde će biti izgrađen profesionalni teren sa 18 rupa, prvih 9 će biti otvoreno do kraja 2023. godine. Generalno, projekat je jedinstveni. Prema rečima stručnjaka, manje od 10% golf terena u svetu pruža mogućnost posmatranja mora sa bilo koje tačke.
Naselje Centrale će postati trgovački, administrativni i kulturni centar.
Tu će biti smeštene glavne gradske službe: obdanište, škola i zdravstveni centar, policijska i vatrogasna stanica, banka, pošta, autoservis i benzinska pumpa, autlet selo, konferencijski centar i sportski kompleksi. U naselju će biti uređeni novi parkovi, uređena šetališta, otvorene galerije, prodavnice i kafići na centralnom trgu.
Cena zemljišta je 9 447 750 e
Površina placa 20 995 m2
Ukupna površina kompleksa - 16 287 m2
HOTEL:
Ukupna površina nadzemnih etaža 8 382,34 m2 Ukupna površina podzemnih etaža 5.956,10 m2 Ukupna površina hotela 14.338,44 m2
KUĆA ZA GOSTE:
Ukupna površina nadzemnih 1.620,60 m2 Ukupna površina podzemnih etaža 328,23 m2 Ukupna površina hotela 1 948, 83 m2

Sale of a land plot with a 5-star hotel project.
The land plot is located on the Montenegrin peninsula Luštica, in the largest bay on the Adriatic Sea - on the coast of Boko Kotorskog zaliva, which is called the southernmost fjord in Europe, 10 minutes from Tivat airport.
The last land plot directly on the seashore where it is still possible to build a 5-star hotel. The nature here is luxurious. Magnificent mountains, azure sea. Secluded coves with fine sandy and pebble beaches are scattered along the coast, and in the surroundings there are pine and olive groves, authentic villages, private estates and vineyards. In a word, an idyll.
Foundations have been laid for the construction of the Golf Residences area. World-renowned player Geri Plejer has been invited to develop the golf course project. Here, an 18-hole professional course will be built, the first 9 will be open by the end of 2023. Generally, the project is unique. According to experts, less than 10% of golf courses in the world offer the possibility of observing the sea from any point.
The Centrale settlement will become a commercial, administrative, and cultural center.
The main city services will be located there: kindergarten, school, and health center, police and fire station, bank, post office, car service, and gas station, outlet village, conference center, and sports complexes. New parks will be arranged in the settlement, arranged promenades, open galleries, shops, and cafes on the central square.
The price of the land plot is 9 447 750 e
Area of the land plot 20 995 m2
Total area of the complex - 16 287 m2

Total area of above-ground floors 8 382,34 m2 Total area of underground floors 5.956,10 m2 Total area of the hotel 14.338,44 m2
GUEST HOUSE:
Total area of above-ground 1.620,60 m2 Total area of underground floors 328,23 m2 Total area of the hotel 1 948, 83 m2

listing.title: Prodaja, jednosoban stan, 42m², Donja Lastva, Tivat
Sale, one bedroom apartment, 42m², Donja Lastva, Tivat
listing.description:
Izuzetna lokacija: Na samo nekoliko minuta hoda od plaža, restorana i šetališta Porto Montenegro.
Kvalitetna završna obrada: Korišćenje prirodnog kamena, sanitarije visokog kvaliteta i klimatizacije poznatih svetskih brendova.
Funkcionalni rasporedi: Maksimalno iskorišćenje prostora i prirodnog svetla zahvaljujući panoramskim prozorima.
Profesionalno upravljanje: Kompleksom će upravljati iskusna upravljačka kompanija.
Lokacija
Stambeni kompleks se nalazi u mirnom delu Tivta, okružen zelenilom i prestižnim rezidencijama.
Prodavnice, restorani, čiste plaže i prestižno šetalište Porto Montenegro - jedna od najelitnijih marina u Evropi - nalaze se na pešačkoj udaljenosti.
Međunarodni aerodrom Tivat udaljen je samo 10 minuta vožnje, što omogućava maksimalnu udobnost putovanja.
Birajući Tivat kao svoj novi dom, postajete deo dinamično rastućeg letovališta sa modernom infrastrukturom, gde je svaki dan ispunjen komforom i novim iskustvima.
Kompleks se sastoji od dve zgrade - Blok A i Blok B.
U svakoj zgradi nalaze se stanovi sa jednom i dve spavaće sobe, prostranim dnevnim boravcima i terasama. Stanovi u prizemlju imaju privatno dvorište (patio).
U prodaji su stanovi površine od 42 m² do 90 m².
Zahvaljujući panoramskim prozorima, stanovi su ispunjeni dnevnim svetlom. Iz većine stanova pruža se prelep pogled na more i grad.

Exceptional location: Just a few minutes' walk from the beaches, restaurants, and Porto Montenegro promenade.
High-quality finishes: Use of natural stone, high-quality sanitary ware, and air conditioning from renowned global brands.
Functional layouts: Maximum utilization of space and natural light thanks to panoramic windows.
Professional management: The complex will be managed by an experienced management company.
Location
The residential complex is located in a quiet part of Tivat, surrounded by greenery and prestigious residences.
Shops, restaurants, clean beaches, and the prestigious Porto Montenegro promenade - one of the most elite marinas in Europe - are within walking distance.
Tivat International Airport is only a 10-minute drive away, allowing for maximum travel comfort.
By choosing Tivat as your new home, you become part of a dynamically growing resort with modern infrastructure, where every day is filled with comfort and new experiences.
The complex consists of two buildings - Blok A and Blok B.
Each building contains apartments with one and two bedrooms, spacious living rooms, and terraces. Ground floor apartments have a private courtyard (patio).
Apartments with areas from 42 m² to 90 m² are available for sale.
Thanks to panoramic windows, the apartments are filled with natural light. Most apartments offer a beautiful view of the sea and the city.

listing.title: Prodaja, dvosoban stan, 141m², Budva, Crna Gora
Sale, two bedroom apartment, 141m², Budva, Crna Gora
listing.description:
Nekretnine Crna Gora,Budva Na prodaju ekskluzivan i luksuzno opremljen dvosoban stan površine 141 m², koji se nalazi u jednom od najelitnijih i najtraženijih rezidencijalnih kompleksa na crnogorskom primorju – Dukley Gardens, na prestižnoj lokaciji poluostrva Zavala u Budvi. Stan je savršeno pozicioniran, sa panoramskim pogledom na Jadransko more i okolne planine, pružajući potpunu privatnost, komfor i savremeni stil života.
Ova vrhunska nekretnina sastoji se od prostranog ulaznog hodnika, elegantnog dnevnog boravka sa panoramskim prozorima, moderne kuhinje sa trpezarijom, dve spavaće sobe, dva kupatila i prostrane terase sa predivnim pogledom. O kompleksu Dukley Gardens:Dukley Gardens predstavlja vrhunac luksuznog stanovanja na jadranskoj obali Crne Gore. Kompleks se nalazi u srcu prirode, ušuškan među mediteranskim zelenilom i kristalno čistim morem, sa direktnim pristupom privatnim plažama. Rezidencije su dizajnirane od strane međunarodno priznatih arhitekata i građene prema najvišim svetskim standardima.
Ekskluzivne pogodnosti za stanare Dukley Gardens:-Privatne peščane plaže sa ležaljkama i opremom-24/7 concierge, obezbeđenje i video nadzor-Spa & wellness centar, zona za rekreaciju-Privatni parking i valet servis-Organizovani prevoz do Starog grada i marine-Golf buggies za kretanje unutar kompleksa-Pristanište i marina za jahte do 70 m-Dukley Beach Lounge & restorani-Usluge čišćenja, perionice i održavanja-Iznajmljivanje automobila, brodova, skutera-Usluge čuvanja dece, letnji kampovi, vrtić-Pametni sistemi za daljinsku kontrolu putem mobilnog uređaja-Usluge izdavanja i upravljanja nekretninom-Catering, organizacija događaja i dostava hraneKupovina ove nekretnine predstavlja jedinstvenu priliku za one koji traže spoj vrhunskog kvaliteta, savremenog dizajna, besprekornog komfora i prestižne adrese na jadranskoj obali. Idealan je kako za privatni boravak, tako i kao investiciona nekretnina za rentiranje, sa potencijalom za visok povrat kroz luksuzni najam.

Real Estate Montenegro, BudvaFor sale is an exclusive, luxuriously furnished two-bedroom apartment with a total area of 141 m², located in one of the most elite and sought-after residential complexes on the Montenegrin coast – Dukley Gardens, situated on the prestigious Zavala Peninsula in Budva. The apartment is perfectly positioned and offers panoramic views of the Adriatic Sea and surrounding mountains, ensuring complete privacy, comfort, and a modern lifestyle.
This high-end property consists of a spacious entrance hall, an elegant living room with panoramic windows, a modern kitchen with a dining area, two bedrooms, two bathrooms, and a large terrace with stunning views. The apartment is fully and luxuriously furnished and ready for immediate move-in with no additional investment required.

listing.title: Prodaja, plac, 1995m², Milovići, Tivat
Sale, land lot, 1995m², Milovići, Tivat
listing.description:
Na prodaju atraktivno građevinsko zemljište ukupne površine 1995m², sa prelijepim pogledom na tivatski zaliv. Parcela je kaskadnog tipa, što omogućava odličnu organizaciju prostora i maksimalno iskorišćenje pogleda.
Na placu su prisutni svi potrebni priključci. Trenutno je ucrtano 300m², uz napomenu da nedostaje još 50m² za dobijanje urbanističko-tehničkih uslova, što je u procesu rješavanja sa nadležnom opštinom.
Idealno za izgradnju vile ili manjeg stambenog objekta u mirnom i perspektivnom okruženju.

For sale, an attractive construction land plot with a total area of 1995m², with a beautiful view of the Bay of Tivat. The plot is of a cascading type, which allows for excellent space organization and maximum utilization of the view.
All necessary connections are present on the land plot. Currently, 300m² is registered, with a note that another 50m² is needed for obtaining urban-technical conditions, which is in the process of resolution with the competent municipality.
Ideal for the construction of a villa or a smaller residential building in a quiet and promising environment.

listing.title: Prodaja, trosoban stan, 282m², Budva, Crna Gora
Sale, three bedroom apartment, 282m², Budva, Crna Gora
listing.description:
Nekretnine, Crna GoraNa prodaju je luksuzan trosoban penthouse stan sa spektakularnim direktnim pogledom na more, smešten u prestižnom kompleksu Dukley Gardens, Budva.
Stan ima površinu od 282m², uz dodatak krovne terase od 235m², idealne za uživanje u panoramskim pogledima i opuštanje na otvorenom.
Ova nekretnina je kompletno završena i useljiva, pružajući vam mogućnost da se odmah uselite i uživate u svim pogodnostima koje nudi.
Postoji mogućnost kupovine ove nekretnine u kriptovaluti Bitcoin, čime se omogućava fleksibilnost u plaćanju.
Dukley Gardens je elitna nekretnina na jadranskoj obali u najslikovitijem mestu Crne Gore. Otkrijte Crnu Goru, zemlju ogromnih prirodnih bogatstava i najčistijeg mora, prirodnih ukusa i pažljivo očuvanih drevnih tradicija. Svaki dan, svaki minut će biti ispunjen harmonijom i lepotom. Od sjajnog izlaska sunca do romantičnog zalaska sunca, čekaju vas nezaboravni utisci koje ćete želeti da iskusite iznova i iznova. Dopustite sebi da se opustite u prostranom i udobnom domu, opustite se na plaži skrivenoj od radoznalih očiju, uživajte u gastronomskoj večeri na ogromnoj terasi sa panoramskim pogledom na Jadran.
Osmišljen od strane međunarodne grupe uglednih projektanata, renomiranih graditelja i nagrađivanih arhitekata, u saradnji sa vrhunskim kreativnim timom konsultanata za dizajn i tehnologiju, Dukley nudi izvanredne sadržaje i usluge. Sa pogledom na jednu od najlepših obala na svetu, ovaj kompleks ekskluzivnih rezidencijalnih vila spaja najmoderniju infrastrukturu, sofisticirani savremeni dizajn i vrhunske sadržaje, podižući ljestvicu kvaliteta primorskih rezidencijalnih kompleksa u Crnoj Gori.
Uz pomoć najsavremenije Smart Home tehnologije koja osigurava kompletnu bezbednost, stanari kompleksa Dukley Gardens mogu kontrolisati svoje stanove koristeći lične uređaje. Putem telefona ili tableta svaki stanar može upravljati osvetljenjem i klima uređajima, kao i multimedija sistemima i sistemima za bezbednost i nadzor u svom stanu.

Real Estate, MontenegroFor sale is a luxurious three-bedroom penthouse apartment with a spectacular direct sea view, located in the prestigious Dukley Gardens complex, Budva.
The apartment has an area of 2282m², along with a 235m² rooftop terrace, perfect for enjoying panoramic views and relaxing outdoors.
This property is fully finished and ready to move in, offering you the opportunity to settle in immediately and enjoy all the amenities it offers.
There is an option to purchase this property using the cryptocurrency Bitcoin, providing flexibility in payment.
Dukley Gardens is an elite property on the Adriatic coast in the most picturesque place in Montenegro. Discover Montenegro, a land of vast natural wealth and the cleanest sea, natural flavors, and carefully preserved ancient traditions. Every day, every moment will be filled with harmony and beauty. From the brilliant sunrise to the romantic sunset, unforgettable impressions await you that you will want to experience again and again. listing.title: Prodaja, ugostiteljski objekat, 400m², Dobrota, Kotor
Sale, hospitality venue, 400m², Dobrota, Kotor
listing.description:
Smještena na samoj obali u Dobroti, Kotor, ova luksuzna vila izgrađena 2025. godine predstavlja rijetku priliku na tržištu nekretnina u Crnoj Gori. Dizajnirana za one koji traže privatnost, vrhunski komfor i otvoren pogled na more, vila savršeno spaja savremenu arhitekturu i mediteranski stil života.
Prostire se na 400 m² i nudi privatni bazen, pažljivo uređeno dvorište i više prostranih terasa idealnih za odmor i uživanje. Direktan izlaz na more dodatno naglašava ekskluzivnost ove nekretnine.
Vila ima kapacitet za 8 osoba i raspolaže sa 5 spavaćih soba i 4 luksuzno opremljena kupatila, uključujući hidromasažnu kadu, bide i vrhunsku opremu. Potpuno je klimatizovana, posjeduje brzi Wi-Fi i privatni parking.
Nalazi se na svega nekoliko minuta od starog grada Kotor i znamenitosti poput Vrata od mora i Kotorska sat kula, dok su Rimski mozaici udaljeni oko 13 km.
Osnovne karakteristike:
• Prva linija mora
• 400 m² stambenog prostora
• 5 spavaćih soba / 4 kupatila
• Privatni bazen i dvorište
• Direktan pristup moru
• Više terasa
• Privatni parking
• Izuzetna investiciona prilika
Savršen izbor za luksuzan život ili kao investicija na jednoj od najtraženijih lokacija na crnogorskom primorju.

Located right on the coast in Dobrota, Kotor, this luxury villa built in 2025 represents a rare opportunity on the real estate market in Montenegro. Designed for those seeking privacy, ultimate comfort, and an open sea view, the villa perfectly combines contemporary architecture and Mediterranean lifestyle.
It spans 400 m² and offers a private pool, a carefully landscaped courtyard, and multiple spacious terraces ideal for relaxation and enjoyment. Direct access to the sea further emphasizes the exclusivity of this property.
The villa has a capacity for 8 people and features 5 bedrooms and 4 luxuriously equipped bathrooms, including a hydromassage tub, bidet, and top-of-the-line equipment. It is fully air-conditioned, has high-speed Wi-Fi, and private parking.
It is located just a few minutes from the old town of Kotor and sights such as Vrata od mora and Kotorska sat kula, while Rimski mozaici are about 13 km away.
Key features:
• First line to the sea
• 400 m² living space
• 5 bedrooms / 4 bathrooms
• Private pool and courtyard
• Direct sea access
• Multiple terraces
• Private parking
• Exceptional investment opportunity
A perfect choice for luxurious living or as an investment in one of the most sought-after locations on the Montenegrin coast.

listing.title: Prodaja, ugostiteljski objekat, 1000m², Dobrota, Kotor
Sale, hospitality venue, 1000m², Dobrota, Kotor
listing.description:
Ekskluzivni butik hotel 5★ na prodaju – Prva linija mora, Dobrota, Kotor
Smješten na samoj obali Bokokotorskog zaliva, svega 3 km od starog grada Kotor, ovaj luksuzni butik hotel sa 5 zvjezdica predstavlja jedinstvenu investicionu priliku na crnogorskom primorju.
Hotel je oličenje sofisticiranosti i diskretnog luksuza, poznat po svom autentičnom konceptu i vrhunskoj usluzi. Raspolaže sa 10 unikatno dizajniranih apartmana, od kojih je svaki inspirisan različitim svjetskim destinacijama – Afrikom, Japanom, Indijom, Dubaijem i drugim egzotičnim kulturama. Svaka soba nudi poseban doživljaj kroz pažljivo birane detalje, vrhunski namještaj i modernu opremu.
Gostima je na raspolaganju privatna plaža, kao i kompletno opremljen Wellness & Spa centar sa turskim kupatilom, finskom saunom, đakuzijem, otvorenim bazenom i moderno opremljenom teretanom. Ovaj prostor pruža potpuni mir i regeneraciju, uz najviši nivo komfora.
U sklopu hotela nalazi se i vrhunski à la carte restoran sa panoramskim pogledom na more, koji nudi spoj nacionalne, mediteranske i internacionalne kuhinje. Sva jela pripremaju se od svježih, lokalnih namirnica, dok bogata vinska karta dodatno upotpunjuje gastronomski doživljaj.
Stari grad Kotora, pod zaštitom UNESCO, nalazi se u neposrednoj blizini i tokom ljeta nudi bogat kulturni i društveni program, što dodatno povećava atraktivnost lokacije.
Ključne karakteristike:
• Prva linija mora / privatna plaža
• 10 luksuznih tematskih apartmana
• Wellness & Spa (sauna, hamam, jacuzzi, bazen)
• Moderan restoran sa vrhunskom kuhinjom
• Teretana (TECHNOGYM oprema)
• Parking i Wi-Fi
• 24/7 concierge i personalizovane usluge
Ovaj hotel već godinama privlači mnoge poznate ličnosti iz svijeta biznisa, sporta i zabave, što potvrđuje njegov prestiž, diskreciju i visok nivo usluge.
Savršena prilika za investitore koji žele preuzeti već uspješan i prepoznat luksuzni koncept na jednoj od najpoželjnijih destinacija na Mediteranu.

Exclusive boutique hotel 5★ for sale – First line to the sea, Dobrota, Kotor
Located directly on the coast of Bokokotorski zaliv, just 3 km from the Old Town of Kotor, this luxurious 5-star boutique hotel represents a unique investment opportunity on the Montenegrin coast.
The hotel is the epitome of sophistication and discreet luxury, known for its authentic concept and top-tier service. It features 10 uniquely designed apartments, each inspired by different world destinations – Africa, Japan, India, Dubai, and other exotic cultures. Each room offers a special experience through carefully selected details, premium furniture, and modern equipment.
Guests have access to a private beach, as well as a fully equipped Wellness & Spa center with a Turkish bath, Finnish sauna, jacuzzi, outdoor pool, and a modernly equipped gym. This space provides complete peace and regeneration, with the highest level of comfort.
The hotel also features a premium à la carte restaurant with panoramic sea views, which offers a blend of national, Mediterranean, and international cuisine. All dishes are prepared from fresh, local ingredients, while a rich wine list further complements the gastronomic experience.
The Old Town of Kotor, under UNESCO protection, is located in the immediate vicinity and during summer offers a rich cultural and social program, which further increases the attractiveness of the location.
Key features:
• First line to the sea / private beach
• 10 luxury themed apartments
• Wellness & Spa (sauna, hammam, jacuzzi, pool)
• Modern restaurant with premium cuisine
• Gym (TECHNOGYM equipment)

listing.title: Prodaja, kuća, 231m², Gornja Gorica, Podgorica

listing.description:
Smještena u mirnoj i prestižnoj rezidencijalnoj zoni Gornje Gorice, predstavlja spoj moderne arhitekture, vrhunskog kvaliteta gradnje i sofisticiranog načina života. Ova ekskluzivna vila površine 231 m² projektovana je sa posebnim fokusom na funkcionalnost, privatnost i dugoročnu vrijednost nekretnine.
Prostran i svijetao enterijer karakterišu otvoreni koncept dnevnog boravka, velike staklene površine i obilje prirodnog svjetla tokom cijelog dana, stvarajući prijatan i elegantan ambijent za svakodnevni život.
Vila posjeduje privatnu wellness zonu koja uključuje grijani bazen sa masažnim mlazovima i luksuznu finsku KYRA saunu, pružajući potpuni osjećaj relaksacije i odmora u udobnosti sopstvenog doma.
Objekat je opremljen naprednim Smart Home sistemom koji omogućava jednostavno upravljanje rasvjetom, grijanjem, hlađenjem, sigurnosnim sistemima i ostalim funkcijama putem mobilnog telefona. Dodatni nivo sigurnosti obezbijeđen je HD video nadzorom, alarmnim sistemom, kontrolom pristupa i perimetarskom zaštitom.
Energetska efikasnost vile postignuta je savremenim sistemima kao što su podno grijanje sa toplotnom pumpom, multi-split i kanalni klima sistemi bez vidljivih unutrašnjih jedinica, kao i unaprijed pripremljena infrastruktura za solarne panele, što omogućava niže troškove energije i održiv način života.
U izgradnji i opremanju korišćeni su premium materijali i renomirani svjetski brendovi poput Porcelanosa keramike, Tarkett parketa, Hansgrohe AXOR i Geberit sanitarnih sistema, Villeroy & Boch opreme, Florim keramike i aluminijumske stolarije, garantujući vrhunsku estetiku, dugotrajnost i visoku tržišnu vrijednost nekretnine.
Lokacija vile pruža idealan balans između privatnosti i urbanog života.

Located in the quiet and prestigious residential zone of Gornja Gorica, it represents a blend of modern architecture, premium construction quality, and a sophisticated lifestyle. This exclusive villa with an area of 231 m² is designed with a special focus on functionality, privacy, and long-term property value.
The spacious and bright interior is characterized by an open-concept living room, large glass surfaces, and an abundance of natural light throughout the day, creating a pleasant and elegant ambiance for everyday life.
The villa has a private wellness zone which includes a heated pool with massage jets and a luxurious Finnish KYRA sauna, providing a complete sense of relaxation and rest in the comfort of your own home.
The property is equipped with an advanced Smart Home system which allows for easy control of lighting, heating, cooling, security systems, and other functions via mobile phone. An additional level of security is provided by HD video surveillance, an alarm system, access control, and perimeter protection.
The energy efficiency of the villa is achieved through modern systems such as underfloor heating with a heat pump, multi-split and ducted air conditioning systems without visible indoor units, as well as pre-prepared infrastructure for solar panels, which enables lower energy costs and a sustainable lifestyle.
Premium materials and renowned global brands were used in the construction and furnishing such as Porcelanosa ceramics, Tarkett parquet, Hansgrohe AXOR and Geberit sanitary systems, Villeroy & Boch equipment, Florim ceramics, and aluminum joinery, guaranteeing superior aesthetics, durability, and high market value of the property.
The villa's location provides an ideal balance between privacy and urban life.

listing.title: Prodaja, garsonjera, 40m², Velika Plaža, Ulcinj
Sale, studio apartment, 40m², Velika Plaža, Ulcinj
listing.description:
Na prodaju studio apartman u luksuznom hotelsko-rezidencijalnom kompleksu na Velikoj plaži u Ulcinju, jednoj od najatraktivnijih lokacija na crnogorskom primorju.
Kompleks se nalazi u prvom redu do mora, na više od 300 metara pješčane plaže, okružen prirodom i zelenilom. U ponudi su studio, jednosobni i dvosobni apartmani, kao i luksuzni penthausi, površina od 37 m² do 260 m².
Projekat je koncipiran kao kondo hotel sa profesionalnim upravljanjem, održavanjem i izdavanjem apartmana, što vlasnicima omogućava ostvarivanje pasivnog prihoda bez dodatnih obaveza. Dobit od izdavanja raspoređuje se prema unaprijed definisanim koeficijentima, u zavisnosti od karakteristika apartmana.
Postoji mogućnost povrata PDV-a od 21% prilikom kupovine preko firme. Predviđene su i projekcije povrata investicije, dok se završetkom narednih faza očekuje značajan rast vrijednosti nekretnina.
Budućim vlasnicima i gostima na raspolaganju će biti sadržaji hotelskog nivoa 5★: više bazena, SPA i wellness centar, restorani i barovi, sportski tereni, mini golf, padel i tenis tereni, dječji klub, joga zona, uređene zelene površine, šetalište sa trgovinama, plažni klub, prirodno jezero i brojni drugi sadržaji. U okviru kompleksa planirano je i 700 parking mjesta.
Završetak prve faze planiran je za 2026. godinu, dok je kompletan projekat predviđen za završetak 2029. godine.

For sale: a studio apartment in a luxury hotel-residential complex on Velika plaža in Ulcinj, one of the most attractive locations on the Montenegrin coast.
The complex is located in the first row to the sea, on more than 300 meters of sandy beach, surrounded by nature and greenery. Available are studio, one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments, as well as luxury penthouses, with areas from 37 m² to 260 m².
The project is conceived as a condo hotel with professional management, maintenance, and apartment rental, which allows owners to generate passive income without additional obligations. Rental profits are distributed according to predefined coefficients, depending on the apartment characteristics.
There is a possibility of VAT refund of 21% when purchasing through a company. Investment return projections are also provided, while a significant increase in property value is expected with the completion of subsequent phases.
Future owners and guests will have access to 5★ hotel-level amenities: multiple swimming pools, a SPA and wellness center, restaurants and bars, sports courts, mini golf, padel and tennis courts, a kids' club, a yoga zone, landscaped green areas, a promenade with shops, a beach club, a natural lake, and numerous other facilities. Within the complex, 700 parking spaces are also planned.
The completion of the first phase is planned for 2026, while the entire project is scheduled for completion in 2029.

Projekat je koncipiran kao kondo hotel sa profesionalnim upravljanjem, održavanjem i izdavanjem apartmana, što vlasnicima omogućava ostvarivanje pasivnog prihoda bez dodatnih obaveza. Dobit od izdavanja raspoređuje se prema unaprijed definisanim koeficijentima, u zavisnosti od karakteristika apartmana.
Postoji mogućnost povrata PDV-a od 21% prilikom kupovine preko firme. Predviđene su i projekcije povrata investicije, dok se završetkom narednih faza očekuje značajan rast vrijednosti nekretnina.

U okviru kompleksa planirano je i 700 parking mjesta.
Završetak prve faze planiran je za 2026. godinu, dok je kompletan projekat predviđen za završetak 2029. godine.

Luksuzan jednosoban apartman površine 82 m² nalazi se u prvom redu do mora, u okviru Portonovi Marina Residences, Herceg Novi.
Apartman se sastoji od prostranog dnevnog boravka otvorenog koncepta sa trpezarijom i kuhinjom, jedne spavaće sobe, kupatila, gostinjskog toaleta i terase površine 19 m². Sa terase se pruža panoramski pogled na more i marinu.

• 85% kroz 36 mesečnih rata bez kamate
Portonovi Montenegro predstavlja ultra-premium rizort destinaciju mediteranskog stila, koja obuhvata 218 rezidencijalnih jedinica svetske klase i vrhunsku marinu za mega jahte, smeštenu na najužem delu ulaza u Bokokotorski zaliv.
Portonovi se nalazi na izuzetnoj lokaciji između planina i mora, sa jedinstvenim pogledom na netaknutu jadransku obalu. Kompleks obuhvata prvi evropski One&Only rizort, luksuzne rezidencije, Henri Chenot destinacijski Health & Wellness Spa centar, svetski poznatu marinu za mega jahte (sa poreskim olakšicama na gorivo do 40%), najveću peščanu plažu u regionu sa luksuznim beach club-om, kao i brojne prodavnice, kafiće, barove i restorane.

Area: 82 m² (63 m² + 19 m² terrace) Bedrooms: 1 Bathrooms: 2 Parking space: 1
Luxurious one-bedroom apartment of 82 m² is located on the first line to the sea, within Portonovi Marina Residences, Herceg Novi.
The apartment consists of a spacious open-concept living room with dining area and kitchen, one bedroom, a bathroom, a guest toilet and a terrace of 19 m². From the terrace there is a panoramic view of the sea and the marina.
The price of the apartment includes one underground parking space (based on the exclusive right of use).
A favorable payment plan has been approved:
• 15% upon signing the sale and purchase agreement (SPA)
• 85% through 36 monthly installments without interest
Portonovi Montenegro represents an ultra-premium Mediterranean-style resort destination, which includes 218 world-class residential units and a top-tier marina for mega yachts, located at the narrowest part of the entrance to Bokokotorski zaliv.
Portonovi is located in an exceptional location between mountains and sea, with a unique view of the untouched Adriatic coast. The complex includes the first European One&Only resort, luxurious residences, the Henri Chenot destination Health & Wellness Spa center, a world-renowned marina for mega yachts (with fuel tax benefits up to 40%), the largest sandy beach in the region with a luxurious beach club, as well as numerous shops, cafes, bars, and restaurants.
