Smješteno uz put koji povezuje Risan i Nikšić Veći dio zemljišta nalazi se na manje od 100 metara od obale Jadranskog mora Okruženo impresivnim pejzažima Bokokotorskog zaliva Odlična povezanost sa Kotorom, Perastom, Tivtom, Porto Montenegrom i međunarodnim aerodromima Mirno okruženje koje pruža privatnost uz blizinu svih važnih sadržaja
Karakteristike nekretnine
Zemljište karakteriše uzdignut i pretežno kamenit teren, tipičan za autentični mediteranski pejzaž koji definiše Bokokotorski zaliv. Prirodna konfiguracija terena omogućava atraktivne vidikovce i jedinstven ambijent koji se rijetko nalazi u neposrednoj blizini mora.
Nekretnina obuhvata kombinaciju šumskog zemljišta, livada i prirodnog kraškog terena, pružajući jedinstven spoj ekološke vrijednosti i investicione atraktivnosti.
Planski status
Zemljište je obuhvaćeno Prostorno-urbanističkim planom Kotora i Prostornim planom posebne namjene za obalno područje Crne Gore.
Nekretnina se nalazi unutar strateški značajne obalne zone koja se prostire do 1.000 metara od obale i pozicionirana je u području predviđenom za buduće plansko uređenje i prostorni razvoj. Detaljne mogućnosti razvoja zavise od pribavljanja urbanističko-tehničkih uslova od nadležnih organa.
17.235 m² premium obalnog zemljišta Prestižna lokacija u Bokokotorskom zalivu Veći dio zemljišta nalazi se na manje od 100 metara od mora
Snažan dugoročni investicioni potencijal Odličan pristup putnoj infrastrukturi

Unique opportunity to purchase premium coastal land in one of the most desirable locations in Montenegro
Located in the picturesque settlement of Lipci, in the magnificent Bokokotorski zaliv, this exceptional land plot represents a unique investment opportunity in a region known for its natural beauty, exclusivity, and growing luxury real estate market.
The property consists of several connected cadastral land plots with a total area of 17,235 m², which together form a spacious estate with exceptional long-term development and investment potential.
Primary location
Located along the road connecting Risan and Nikšić A larger portion of the land is located less than 100 meters from the coast of Jadransko more Surrounded by impressive landscapes of Bokokotorski zaliv Excellent connectivity to Kotor, Perast, Tivat, Porto Montenegro, and international airports Peaceful surroundings providing privacy with proximity to all important amenities
Property characteristics
The land is characterized by elevated and predominantly rocky terrain, typical of the authentic Mediterranean landscape that defines Bokokotorski zaliv. The natural configuration of the terrain allows for attractive viewpoints and a unique ambiance rarely found in the immediate vicinity of the sea.
The property includes a combination of forest land, meadows, and natural karst terrain, providing a unique blend of ecological value and investment attractiveness.
Planning status
The land is covered by the Spatial-Urban Plan of Kotor and the Spatial Plan of Special Purpose for the Coastal Area of Montenegro.
The property is located within a strategically significant coastal zone extending up to 1,000 meters from the coast and is positioned in an area designated for future planning and spatial development. Detailed development possibilities depend on obtaining urban-technical conditions from the competent authorities.
17,235 m² premium coastal land Prestigious location in Bokokotorski zaliv A larger portion of the land is located less than 100 meters from the sea
Strong long-term investment potential Excellent access to road infrastructure

listing.title: Prodaja, plac, 18413m², Centar, Nikšić
Sale, land lot, 18413m², Centar, Nikšić
listing.description:
Predmetna nepokretnost nalazi se u području naselja Šipačno, u Opštini Nikšić, na mirnoj lokaciji udaljenoj približno 15 kilometara od centra grada i oko 2,7 kilometara od magistralnog puta, što omogućava povezanost sa širom saobraćajnom mrežom.
Ukupna površina zemljišta iznosi 18.413 m². Lokacija se odlikuje prirodnim ambijentom i predstavlja dio područja obuhvaćenog važećom prostorno-planskom dokumentacijom Opštine Nikšić.
Prema planskoj namjeni, zemljište se nalazi u zoni šumskih površina, koje su predviđene za očuvanje i unapređenje šumskog fonda, kao i za aktivnosti u funkciji gazdovanja šumama. U okviru ove zone dozvoljena je izgradnja objekata namijenjenih održavanju i unapređenju šumskih resursa, šumskih saobraćajnica, kao i planinarskih i lovačkih domova.
Nekretnina predstavlja interesantnu priliku za investitore i korisnike zainteresovane za zemljište većih površina u prirodnom okruženju, sa potencijalom za razvoj sadržaja usklađenih sa planskom namjenom i principima održivog korišćenja prostora.

The subject property is located in the area of the settlement Šipačno, in the Municipality of Nikšić, in a quiet location approximately 15 kilometers from the city center and about 2.7 kilometers from the main road, which allows connection to the wider transport network.
The total land plot area is 18,413 m². The location is characterized by a natural environment and represents a part of the area covered by the valid spatial planning documentation of the Municipality of Nikšić.
According to the planned use, the land plot is located in a zone of forest areas, which are intended for the preservation and improvement of the forest fund, as well as for activities related to forest management. Within this zone, the construction of facilities intended for the maintenance and improvement of forest resources, forest roads, as well as mountaineering and hunting lodges is permitted.
The property represents an interesting opportunity for investors and users interested in larger land plots in a natural environment, with the potential for developing content aligned with the planned use and principles of sustainable space utilization.

listing.title: Prodaja, plac, 8662m², Njeguši, Cetinje
Sale, land lot, 8662m², Njeguši, Cetinje
listing.description:
Predmetne nepokretnosti nalaze se na području Njeguša, u Prijestonici Cetinje, u neposrednoj blizini ulazno-kontrolnog punkta Nacionalnog parka Lovćen. Riječ je o atraktivnoj lokaciji prepoznatoj po izuzetnim prirodnim vrijednostima, autentičnom ambijentu i značajnom turističkom potencijalu.
Zemljište je organizovano u više prostornih cjelina, od kojih pojedine imaju direktan pristup lokalnim i regionalnim saobraćajnicama, uključujući putni pravac Kotor–Njeguši–Cetinje, dok se dio površina nalazi u prirodnom okruženju bez neposrednog pristupa javnim putevima.
Prema važećoj prostorno-planskoj dokumentaciji, zemljište obuhvata zone namijenjene stanovanju male gustine, poljoprivrednim površinama, šumama i ostalim prirodnim površinama. Dio lokacija posjeduje potencijal za izgradnju stambenih i pomoćnih objekata, kao i objekata u funkciji poljoprivredne djelatnosti, uz poštovanje urbanističko-tehničkih uslova i važećih planskih ograničenja.
Prirodno okruženje, blizina Nacionalnog parka Lovćen i dobra povezanost sa Cetinjem i Bokokotorskim zalivom daju ovoj nekretnini poseban investicioni značaj. Kombinacija različitih namjena zemljišta pruža mogućnost razvoja sadržaja usklađenih sa principima održivog korišćenja prostora, poljoprivrede i ruralnog turizma.
Zahvaljujući jedinstvenoj lokaciji u jednom od najprepoznatljivijih predjela Crne Gore, predmetne nepokretnosti predstavljaju interesantnu priliku za investitore i korisnike zainteresovane za razvoj projekata u skladu sa prirodnim i prostornim karakteristikama ovog područja.

The subject properties are located in the area of Njeguši, in the Capital City of Cetinje, in the immediate vicinity of the entrance control point of Lovćen National Park. It is an attractive location recognized for its exceptional natural values, authentic ambiance, and significant tourism potential.
The land is organized into several spatial units, some of which have direct access to local and regional roads, including the Kotor–Njeguši–Cetinje road, while some areas are in a natural environment without direct access to public roads.
According to the valid spatial planning documentation, the land includes zones designated for low-density housing, agricultural areas, forests, and other natural areas. Part of the locations have potential for the construction of residential and auxiliary buildings, as well as buildings for agricultural activities, with respect to urban-technical conditions and valid planning restrictions.
The natural environment, the proximity of Lovćen National Park, and good connectivity with Cetinje and Bokokotorski zaliv give this property special investment significance. The combination of different land uses provides the opportunity to develop content aligned with the principles of sustainable spatial use, agriculture, and rural tourism.
Thanks to its unique location in one of the most recognizable regions of Crna Gora, the subject properties represent an interesting opportunity for investors and users interested in developing projects in accordance with the natural and spatial characteristics of this area.

listing.title: Prodaja, dvosoban stan, 87m², Budva okolina, Budva
Sale, two bedroom apartment, 87m², Budva okolina, Budva
listing.description:
Luksuzni stambeno-apartmanski kompleks sa sadržajima na nivou hotela sa 5 zvjezdica, smješten na uzvišenju u Budvi, pruža spektakularan panoramski pogled na more, Stari grad, Sveti Stefan i okolne planine. Odlična lokacija omogućava brz pristup plažama i kompletnoj gradskoj infrastrukturi, uz istovremeno mirno i privatno okruženje.
Kompleks nudi bogat sadržaj za stanare i goste, uključujući infinity bazen sa pogledom na more, zatvoreni i otvoreni grijani bazen, SPA centar, saune, hamam, fitness i teretanu, dječju igraonicu, konferencijsku salu, coworking prostor i profesionalnu concierge uslugu.
Posebnu vrijednost predstavljaju prostrane terase sa zelenim površinama, kao i ekskluzivni penthausi sa privatnim wellness zonama, jacuzzijem i otvorenim kuhinjama. Projekat kombinuje vrhunski komfor, moderan mediteranski dizajn i izuzetan investicioni potencijal, uz mogućnost ostvarivanja prihoda od izdavanja i dugoročnog rasta vrijednosti nekretnine.
Dostupna su i parking mjesta u podzemnoj garaži po cijeni od 25.000 €, kao i ostave: manja ostava 9.000 €, a veća ostava 10.000 €.

Luxury residential and apartment complex with 5-star hotel-level amenities, located on a hill in Budva, offers a spectacular panoramic view of the sea, Old Town, Sveti Stefan, and the surrounding mountains. Excellent location provides quick access to beaches and complete city infrastructure, along with a simultaneously peaceful and private environment.
The complex offers rich content for residents and guests, including an infinity pool with sea view, indoor and outdoor heated pool, SPA center, saunas, hammam, fitness, and gym, children's playroom, conference hall, coworking space, and professional concierge service.
Of particular value are the spacious terraces with green areas, as well as exclusive penthouses with private wellness zones, jacuzzis, and open kitchens. The project combines top comfort, modern Mediterranean design, and exceptional investment potential, with the possibility of generating rental income and long-term property value growth.
Parking spaces are also available in the underground garage at a price of 25.000 €, as well as storage rooms: smaller storage room 9.000 €, and larger storage room 10.000 €.

listing.title: Izdavanje, trosoban stan, 108m², Malo Brdo, Podgorica
Rent, three bedroom apartment, 108m², Malo Brdo, Podgorica
listing.description:
Naslov: Izdaje se luksuzan trosoban stan 108m2 – Malo brdo, Podgorica
Opis:
Izdaje se prostran, komforan i izuzetno funkcionalan trosoban stan površine 108m2 na atraktivnoj i mirnoj lokaciji u naselju Malo brdo. Stan se nalazi na četvrtom spratu stambene zgrade koja posjeduje lift, a udaljen je svega 2,2 km od samog centra grada, 5-8min automobilom.
Stan je pažljivo zoniran na dnevni i noćni blok, pružajući maksimalnu privatnost i udobnost.
Struktura stana:
• Dnevna zona: Ulazni hol, prostrani dnevni boravak sa izlazom na lođu, odvojena trpezarija, kuhinja sa praktičnom ostavom i gostinski toalet.
• Zona za odmor (noćni blok): Komforna master spavaća soba sa sopstvenim garderoberom, veliko kupatilo, kao i dvije dječije spavaće sobe. Jedna dječija soba ima izlaz na otvorenu terasu, dok druga izlazi na zastakljenu/zatvorenu terasu koja je opremljena modernom opremom za fitnes.
Karakteristike i materijali:
Stan je građen od vrhunskih materijala, što garantuje odličnu termo i zvučnu izolaciju:

listing.title: Izdavanje, kuća, 140m², Brajići, Budva
Rent, house, 140m², Brajići, Budva
listing.description:
Brajici se nalaze na oko 800 m nadmorske visine, nadomak Budve, poznati kao vazdušna banja zahvaljujući spoju morske i planinske klime.
Poseban značaj daje im tvrđava Kosmač, izgrađena između 1841. i 1850. godine, nekada na granici između Crne Gore i Austrije.
Turističku ponudu upotpunjuju Zip Line, paraglajding i restoran „Sidro“, čineći Brajiće idealnim mjestom za odmor, rekreaciju i avanturu.
Udaljeni su oko 10 km od Cetinja, 12 km od Budve i 50 km od Podgorice.

Brajici are located at about 800 m above sea level, near Budva, known as an air spa thanks to the combination of sea and mountain climate.
Special significance is given to them by Kosmač fortress, built between 1841 and 1850, once on the border between Montenegro and Austria.
The tourist offer is complemented by Zip Line, paragliding and restaurant "Sidro", making Brajici an ideal place for rest, recreation, and adventure.
They are about 10 km from Cetinje, 12 km from Budva and 50 km from Podgorica.

listing.title: Prodaja, kuća, 284m², Đenovići, Herceg Novi
Sale, house, 284m², Đenovići, Herceg Novi
listing.description:
Ekskluzivna kuća uz more
Jedinstvena nekretnina smještena neposredno uz more, na parceli od 460 m², sa stambenim objektom površine 175 m² i uređenim privatnim dvorištem 284 m².
Kuća je kompletno rekonstruisana i puštena u funkciju 2014. godine, uz posebnu pažnju posvećenu konstrukciji, sigurnosti i kvalitetu materijala. Objekat je izveden kao monolitna armiranobetonska konstrukcija, oslonjena na 23 armiranobetonska šipa dubine 8 m.
Tri etaže nude prostran i pažljivo organizovan životni prostor: više spavaćih soba sa privatnim kupatilima i garderobama, dnevni boravak, kuhinju, kancelariju, saunu, garažu i više terasa, lođa i balkona sa pogledom prema moru.
Poseban karakter objektu daje prirodni kamen, kojim su obloženi fasada, lođe, veranda, podovi i ograda imanja, stvarajući autentičan mediteranski ambijent.
Privatno dvorište predstavlja posebnu vrijednost nekretnine. Posjeduje parking, privatni mol, vučnicu za čamce, prostor za odmor i direktan izlaz na plažu. Pristup imanju omogućen je sa dvije strane.
Komfor tokom cijele godine obezbjeđuju podno grijanje, Mitsubishi toplotna pumpa i solarni paneli, uz mogućnost hlađenja prostora tokom ljetnih mjeseci. Kuća je opremljena i rezervnim napajanjem električnom energijom i vodom, alarmnim sistemom i video-nadzorom.
Nekretnina koja pruža rijetku kombinaciju privatnosti, sigurnosti, vrhunske konstrukcije i neposrednog kontakta sa morem — sa sopstvenim molom i direktnim pristupom plaži.

Exclusive house by the sea
A unique property located directly by the sea, on a land plot of 460 m², with a residential building of 175 m² and a landscaped private courtyard of 284 m².
The house was completely reconstructed and put into operation in 2014, with special attention paid to construction, safety, and material quality. The building was constructed as a monolithic reinforced concrete structure, supported by 23 reinforced concrete piles 8 m deep.
Three floors offer spacious and carefully organized living space: multiple bedrooms with private bathrooms and wardrobes, a living room, kitchen, office, sauna, garage, and multiple terraces, loggias, and balconies with sea views.
A special character is given to the property by natural stone, which covers the facade, loggias, veranda, floors, and property fence, creating an authentic Mediterranean ambiance.
The private courtyard represents a special value of the property. It features parking, a private pier, a boat lift, a relaxation area, and direct access to the beach. Access to the property is available from two sides.
Year-round comfort is provided by underfloor heating, a Mitsubishi heat pump, and solar panels, with the possibility of cooling the space during the summer months. The house is also equipped with backup power supply for electricity and water, an alarm system, and video surveillance.
A property that offers a rare combination of privacy, security, top-tier construction, and direct contact with the sea — with its own pier and direct access to the beach.

listing.title: Prodaja, jednosoban stan, 49m², Portonovi, Herceg Novi

listing.description:
Rezidencijalni kompleks sa pogledom na Bokokotorski zaliv
Smješten u Herceg Novom, u neposrednoj blizini prestižnog Portonovi rizorta i svega oko 200 metara od mora, ovaj savremeni rezidencijalni kompleks predstavlja atraktivnu priliku za život, odmor i investiranje.
Kompleks obuhvata 56 stambenih jedinica, sa jednosobnim (1+1) i dvosobnim (2+1) stanovima. Zahvaljujući atraktivnoj lokaciji i okolnoj izgradnji, stanovi nude otvoren pogled prema moru i Bokokotorskom zalivu.
Stanovi 1+1: 48,56 – 58,79 m² Cijena: 350.000 – 430.100 € Cijena zavisi od spratnosti i pozicije.
Sadržaji kompleksa
Stanovnicima i gostima na raspolaganju su brojni sadržaji:
• otvoreni i zatvoreni bazen
• moderna teretana
• tursko kupatilo i sauna
• prostor za odmor i kafić
• dječije igralište
• recepcija i obezbjeđenje
• otvoreni parking i podzemna garaža
• lift za automobile
• stanica za punjenje električnih vozila
• rezervni generator za kontinuirano snabdijevanje električnom energijom
Investiciona vrijednost
Kompleks je pogodan za kratkoročno i dugoročno izdavanje, kao i za privatno korišćenje. Kupcima koji nekretninu kupuju kao investiciju biće pružena podrška u procesu izdavanja i upravljanja rentiranjem.
Lokacija u neposrednoj blizini Portonovi rizorta, luksuznih vila, marine i hotela dodatno povećava atraktivnost nekretnine. Hotel One&Only nalazi se na približno 150 metara, dok je plaža udaljena oko 400 metara. U okolini se nalaze restorani, prodavnice, škole, parkovi i drugi sadržaji.
Finansiranje i plan plaćanja
Predviđen je fleksibilan model kupovine:
• 50% početnog učešća
• 50% kroz mjesečne ili kvartalne rate do 24 mjeseca
• dinamika plaćanja se može uskladiti sa individualnim dogovorom i fazom izgradnje
Dostupna je i mogućnost kreditnog finansiranja do 30% vrijednosti nekretnine putem partnerskih banaka Erste i Ziraat, uz planirano proširenje saradnje sa Adriatic bankom.
Šta je uključeno u cijenu
U cijenu stana uključeni su PDV i kuhinjski namještaj. Kuhinjski aparati nijesu uključeni.
Troškovi prenosa vlasništva, notarske i druge administrativne takse nijesu uključeni.
Parking se prodaje posebno:
• Otvoreno parking mjesto: 10.000 €
• Podzemno garažno mjesto: 30.000 €
Ova nekretnina predstavlja spoj luksuzne lokacije, savremenih sadržaja, pogleda na more i investicionog potencijala, pogodnog kako za vlastito korišćenje, tako i za prihod od izdavanja.

Residential complex with a view of Bokokotorski zaliv
Located in Herceg Novom, in the immediate vicinity of the prestigious Portonovi resort and only about 200 meters from the sea, this modern residential complex represents an attractive opportunity for living, vacation, and investment.
The complex includes 56 residential units, with one-bedroom (1+1) and two-bedroom (2+1) apartments. Thanks to the attractive location and surrounding construction, the apartments offer an open view towards the sea and Bokokotorski zaliv.
Apartments 1+1: 48,56 – 58,79 m² Price: 350.000 – 430.100 € The price depends on the floor and position.
Complex amenities
Numerous amenities are available to residents and guests:
• outdoor and indoor pool
• modern gym
• Turkish bath and sauna
• relaxation area and cafe
• children's playground
• reception and security
• outdoor parking and underground garage
• car elevator
• electric vehicle charging station
• backup generator for continuous electricity supply
Investment value
The complex is suitable for short-term and long-term rental, as well as for private use. Buyers who purchase the property as an investment will be provided with support in the process of renting out and rental management.
The location in the immediate vicinity of Portonovi resort, luxury villas, marina, and hotels further increases the attractiveness of the property. Hotel One&Only is located approximately 150 meters away, while the beach is about 400 meters away. In the surroundings, there are restaurants, shops, schools, parks, and other amenities.
Financing and payment plan
A flexible purchase model is foreseen:
• 50% initial down payment
• 50% through monthly or quarterly installments up to 24 months
• payment dynamics can be aligned with individual agreement and the construction phase
The possibility of loan financing up to 30% of the property value through partner banks Erste and Ziraat, with a planned expansion of cooperation with Adriatic bank, is also available.
What is included in the price
The apartment price includes VAT and kitchen furniture. Kitchen appliances are not included.
Costs of ownership transfer, notary, and other administrative fees are not included.
Parking is sold separately:
• Outdoor parking space: 10.000 €
• Underground garage space: 30.000 €
This property represents a combination of luxury location, modern amenities, sea views, and investment potential, suitable for both private use and rental income.

listing.title: Prodaja, jednosoban stan, 71m², Donji Stoliv, Kotor
Sale, one bedroom apartment, 71m², Donji Stoliv, Kotor
listing.description:
JEDNOSOBNI DELUXE APARTMAN
Predstavljamo ekskluzivne Deluxe rezidencije u okviru jednog od najluksuznijih rizorta u Kotoru, namijenjene kupcima koji traže spoj privatnog luksuza, hotelskog servisa i mogućnosti ostvarivanja prihoda kroz profesionalni rental program.
Jednosobni Deluxe apartman ima ukupnu površinu od 71,0 m², koja obuhvata 53,1 m² unutrašnjeg prostora i 17,9 m² privatne terase.
Apartman se sastoji od prostranog dnevnog boravka sa kuhinjom površine 27,2 m², spavaće sobe od 15,7 m², kupatila od 5,8 m² i ulaznog prostora sa hodnikom od 4,5 m².
Rezidencija je potpuno namještena i uređena u savremenom mediteranskom stilu, sa privatnom terasom koja predstavlja produžetak životnog prostora.
Pogodnosti za vlasnike uključuju:
• Pristup spa i fitness centru • Bazen • Hotelske restorane uz rezervaciju • 24/7 concierge servis • Profesionalno upravljanje • Premium namještaj i opremu • Wi-Fi i kablovsku TV • Parking, gdje je primjenjivo • Prioritetni pristup resort sadržajima i iskustvima • Posebne vlasničke popuste
RENTAL PROGRAM
Rezidencija može biti uključena u hotelski rental program i predstavljena kao dio jedinstvenog 5★ hotelskog iskustva.
Hotelski operator preuzima marketing, rezervacije, komunikaciju sa gostima, čišćenje, održavanje i druge operativne aktivnosti.
U skladu sa zakonskim zahtjevima, najmanje 10 mjeseci godišnje predviđeno je za komercijalnu upotrebu.
CIJENA I USLOVI
Početna cijena: €490.000 + PDV
Cijena zavisi od sprata, orijentacije i veličine vanjskog prostora.
Plaćanje: 20% prilikom potpisivanja ugovora 4 jednake rate prema građevinskim fazama Puna uplata do maja 2027.
OGRANIČENA DOSTUPNOST
Dostupan je ograničen broj od ukupno 21 jednosobnog apartmana.
Rana kupovina omogućava izbor između dostupnih jedinica i korišćenje preferencijalnih uslova tokom privatne prodajne faze.

ONE-BEDROOM DELUXE APARTMENT
Introducing exclusive Deluxe residences within one of the most luxurious resorts in Kotor, designed for buyers seeking a blend of private luxury, hotel service, and the opportunity to generate income through a professional rental program.
The one-bedroom Deluxe apartment has a total area of 71,0 m², which includes 53,1 m² of interior space and 17,9 m² of private terrace.
The apartment consists of a spacious living room with kitchen covering 27,2 m², a bedroom of 15,7 m², a bathroom of 5,8 m², and an entrance area with a hallway of 4,5 m².
The residence is fully furnished and decorated in a contemporary Mediterranean style, with a private terrace that serves as an extension of the living space.
Benefits for owners include:
• Access to spa and fitness center • Swimming pool • Hotel restaurants by reservation • 24/7 concierge service • Professional management • Premium furniture and equipment • Wi-Fi and cable TV • Parking, where applicable • Priority access to resort amenities and experiences • Special owner discounts
RENTAL PROGRAM
The residence can be included in the hotel rental program and presented as part of a unique 5★ hotel experience.
The hotel operator takes care of marketing, reservations, guest communication, cleaning, maintenance, and other operational activities.
In accordance with legal requirements, at least 10 months per year are designated for commercial use.
PRICE AND TERMS
Starting price: €490.000 + VAT
The price depends on the floor, orientation, and size of the outdoor space.
Payment: 20% upon signing the contract 4 equal installments according to construction phases Full payment by May 2027.
LIMITED AVAILABILITY

Na prodaju veća zemljišna cjelina u blizini Ulcinja, svega 800–900 m od Solane i oko 2,5 km od Štoja i Velike plaže. Zemljište ima odličan pogled, pristup asfaltiranim putem, kao i dostupnu struju i vodu.
Ukupno je parcelisano 140 parcela, površine oko 600 m² i više, uz prostor za puteve.
Prvih 31 parcela, ukupne površine oko 20.000 m², već imaju UTU uslove. Na njima je moguća izgradnja oko 31 vile, do približno 250 m² po objektu, uz mogućnost objedinjavanja parcela i izgradnje hotela ili drugog turističkog kompleksa.
Preostalih oko 75.000–80.000 m² predstavlja dodatni razvojni potencijal, gdje se UTU uslovi mogu pribavljati u skladu sa idejom i projektom investitora.

• preostalih 75.000–80.000 m² – 80 €/m²

FOR SALE INVESTMENT LAND PLOT – ULCINJ
For sale a larger land plot near Ulcinj, only 800–900 m from Solana and about 2.5 km from Štoj and Velika plaža. The land plot has an excellent view, access via paved road, as well as available electricity and water.
A total of 140 land plots have been parceled, with an area of about 600 m² and more, with space for roads.
The first 31 land plots, with a total area of about 20,000 m², already have UTU conditions. On them, the construction of about 31 villas is possible, up to approximately 250 m² per building, with the possibility of combining land plots and building a hotel or another tourist complex.
The remaining about 75,000–80,000 m² represents additional development potential, where UTU conditions can be obtained in accordance with the investor's idea and project.
Suitable for the construction of a tourist complex, resort, hotel, villas with pools, clinics with apartments or a similar project.
Price:

• remaining 75,000–80,000 m² – 80 €/m²

listing.title: Prodaja, kuća, 295m², Blizikuće, Budva
Sale, house, 295m², Blizikuće, Budva
listing.description:
EKSKLUZIVNI TOWNHOUSE PROJEKAT
Predstavljamo vam ekskluzivan kompleks od 9 luksuznih townhouse vila, projektovanih za savršen spoj modernog dizajna, komfora, privatnosti i prirodnog okruženja.
Smešten na jednoj od najatraktivnijih lokacija crnogorskog primorja, kompleks pruža panoramski pogled na Jadransko more, planine i Sveti Stefan. Mirna lokacija, visok standard gradnje i odlična povezanost sa najpoznatijim destinacijama čine ovaj projekat idealnim za luksuzno stanovanje, odmor ili investiciju sa potencijalom za profitabilno izdavanje.
ISTAKNUTA JEDINICA – TOWNHOUSE C-2 | 295 m²
Kompleks je organizovan u tri objekta – A, B i C – sa po tri townhouse jedinice, ukupno 9 ekskluzivnih vila. Svaka vila prostire se na četiri nivoa i pažljivo je osmišljena kako bi pružila maksimalnu funkcionalnost, privatnost i uživanje u panoramskom pogledu.
Glavne karakteristike vila:
• 4 prostrane spavaće sobe sa sopstvenim kupatilima
• 2 dnevne zone
• 2 potpuno opremljene kuhinje
• privatni bazen
• prostrane terase sa pogledom na more
• garaža za 2 automobila
• visoki plafoni od 3 m
• panoramski prozori visine 2,5 m
• video nadzor i interfon
• multi-split klima sistem
• optički internet
• sistem zaštite od požara
• centralno zagrevanje vode
• rezervni tehnički sistemi
VRHUNSKI STANDARDI GRADNJE
Arhitektura vila kombinuje savremenu estetiku sa prirodnim i kvalitetnim materijalima. Eksterijer karakteriše prirodni kamen, dok energetski efikasna aluminijumska stolarija i velike staklene površine obezbeđuju obilje prirodnog svetla i neometan pogled prema moru.
Enterijer je opremljen pažljivo odabranim materijalima visokog kvaliteta, uključujući hrastov parket u spavaćim sobama, vrhunsku keramiku i sanitarije renomiranog brenda Villeroy & Boch. Svaka vila poseduje kompletan smart tehnički i sigurnosni sistem.
PRIVATNI BAZEN
Privatni bazen predstavlja idealno mesto za opuštanje i uživanje tokom toplih letnjih dana. Opremljen je kompletnim sistemom za filtraciju, osvetljenje i održavanje, pružajući vlasnicima visok nivo komfora i privatnosti.
ATRAKTIVNA LOKACIJA
Projekat se nalazi u mirnom i privatnom okruženju, a istovremeno je odlično povezan sa najvažnijim destinacijama crnogorskog primorja:
• 5 minuta do Svetog Stefana
• 10 minuta do Budve
• 30 minuta do Porto Montenegra i Kotora
• oko 50 minuta do aerodroma Tivat
• oko 50 minuta do aerodroma Podgorica
USLOVI PLAĆANJA
• 5.000 € – rezervacija
• 10% – pri potpisu ugovora
• 30% – nakon završetka grubih radova
• 30% – nakon završetka finih radova
• 30% – po dobijanju upotrebne dozvole, umanjeno za iznos rezervacije
Ovaj projekat predstavlja izuzetnu priliku za kupce koji žele luksuznu rezidenciju na crnogorskom primorju, ali i za investitore zainteresovane za visokoprofitabilno turističko izdavanje.
Townhouse C-2 | 295 m² – spoj savremenog luksuza, privatnosti i jedinstvenog pogleda na Jadran.

EXCLUSIVE TOWNHOUSE PROJECT
We present an exclusive complex of 9 luxury townhouse villas, designed for a perfect blend of modern design, comfort, privacy, and natural surroundings.
Located in one of the most attractive locations on the Montenegrin coast, the complex offers panoramic views of Jadransko more, mountains, and Sveti Stefan. A quiet location, high construction standards, and excellent connectivity to the most famous destinations make this project ideal for luxury living, vacation, or investment with potential for profitable rental.
FEATURED UNIT – TOWNHOUSE C-2 | 295 m²
The complex is organized into three buildings – A, B, and C – each with three townhouse units, totaling 9 exclusive villas. Each villa spans four levels and is carefully designed to provide maximum functionality, privacy, and enjoyment of the panoramic view.
Main characteristics of the villas:
• 4 spacious bedrooms with private bathrooms
• 2 living areas
• 2 fully equipped kitchens
• private pool
• spacious terraces with sea views
• garage for 2 cars
• high ceilings of 3 m
• panoramic windows 2.5 m high
• video surveillance and intercom
• multi-split air conditioning system
• fiber optic internet
• fire protection system
• central water heating
• backup technical systems
PREMIUM CONSTRUCTION STANDARDS
The architecture of the villas combines contemporary aesthetics with natural and quality materials. The exterior features natural stone, while energy-efficient aluminum joinery and large glass surfaces ensure abundant natural light and unobstructed sea views.
The interior is equipped with carefully selected high-quality materials, including oak parquet in the bedrooms, premium ceramics, and sanitary ware from the renowned brand Villeroy & Boch. Each villa features a complete smart technical and security system.
PRIVATE POOL
The private pool is an ideal place for relaxation and enjoyment during warm summer days. It is equipped with a complete system for filtration, lighting, and maintenance, providing owners with a high level of comfort and privacy.
ATTRACTIVE LOCATION
The project is located in a quiet and private environment, while also being well-connected to the most important destinations of the Montenegrin coast:
• 5 minutes to Sveti Stefan
• 10 minutes to Budva
• 30 minutes to Porto Montenegro and Kotor
• about 50 minutes to Tivat airport
• about 50 minutes to Podgorica airport
PAYMENT TERMS
• 5,000 € – reservation
• 10% – upon signing the contract
• 30% – after completion of rough works
• 30% – after completion of fine works
• 30% – upon obtaining the occupancy permit, reduced by the reservation amount
This project represents an exceptional opportunity for buyers seeking a luxury residence on the Montenegrin coast, as well as for investors interested in high-profit tourist rentals.
Townhouse C-2 | 295 m² – a blend of contemporary luxury, privacy, and unique views of the Adriatic.

listing.title: Prodaja, kuća, 220m², Reževići, Budva
Sale, house, 220m², Reževići, Budva
listing.description:
Na prodaju je luksuzna townhouse vila površine 220 m² sa privatnom parcelom od 154 m² i bazenom, smeštena u prestižnom i mirnom delu Budvanske rivijere – Reževićima. Vila se prostire na tri sprata i potkrovlje i obuhvata pet spavacih soba,pet kupatila, dva prostrana dnevna boravka i dve kuhinje. Panoramski prozori od 2,5 m i visoki plafoni od 3 m stvaraju osećaj prostranosti i obilja prirodne svetlosti, dok dve terase nude nezaboravan pogled na Jadransko more. Na parceli se nalazi privatni bazen, uređeno i ozelenjeno dvorište, kao i parking prostor za dva automobila.
Kupovina ove nekretnine donosi posebne pogodnosti – mogućnost odloženog plaćanja (30% prilikom kupovine, a ostatak u roku od godinu dana), kao i oslobađanje od poreza na prenos vlasništva (3%). Takođe, vlasnici ostvaruju pravo na boravišnu dozvolu u Crnoj Gori.
Ono što ovu nekretninu čini posebnom jeste kombinacija vrhunskog kvaliteta gradnje i savremene opreme. Enterijer krase prirodni kamen, keramika premium klase i moderna stolarija, dok je kuhinja ugrađena i kompletno opremljena. Vila poseduje smart home sistem, optički internet, video nadzor, alarmni sistem, centralni bojler, rezervoar za vodu i bio-septički sistem. Dvorište ima automatizovan sistem za navodnjavanje kojim se upravlja online.
Lokacija nudi savršen balans mira i povezanosti – vila je deo zatvorenog, ograđenog kompleksa u prirodnom okruženju, a istovremeno se nalazi svega 10 minuta vožnje od Budve, 5 minuta od Svetog Stefana, 30 minuta od Kotora, Porto Montenegra i Luštica Bay-a, te 50 minuta od aerodroma u Tivtu i Podgorici. Plaže sa kristalno čistim morem su u neposrednoj blizini, a za ljubitelje zime skijališta su udaljena oko dva sata vožnje. Ova vila predstavlja jedinstvenu priliku za luksuzan porodični život, ali i za unosnu investiciju zahvaljujući velikom potencijalu za izdavanje. Dostupna je kompletna profesionalna usluga održavanja i menadžmenta rentiranja, što omogućava stabilan pasivan prihod.

For sale is a luxury townhouse villa with an area of 220 m² and a private plot of 154 m² with a swimming pool, located in the prestigious and peaceful part of the Budva Riviera — Reževići.
The villa spreads over three floors and an attic and includes five bedrooms, five bathrooms, two spacious living areas and two kitchens.
Panoramic windows of 2.5 m and high ceilings of 3 m create a feeling of spaciousness and abundance of natural light, while two terraces offer a breathtaking view of the Adriatic Sea. There is a private pool on the plot, a landscaped and green courtyard, as well as parking space for two cars.
Buying this property brings special benefits — the possibility of deferred payment (30% at the time of purchase, the rest within a year), as well as exemption from the property transfer tax (3%). Also, the owners receive the right to a residence permit in Montenegro.
What makes this property special is the combination of top-quality construction and modern equipment. The interior is decorated with natural stone, premium ceramics and modern carpentry, while the kitchen is built-in and fully equipped.
The villa has a smart home system, optical internet, video surveillance, an alarm system, a central boiler, a water tank and a bio-septic system. The courtyard has an automated irrigation system that is controlled online.
The location offers a perfect balance of peace and connectivity — the villa is part of a closed, fenced complex in a natural environment, and at the same time it is only 10 minutes by car from Budva, 5 minutes from Sveti Stefan, 30 minutes from Kotor, Porto Montenegro and Luštica Bay, and 50 minutes from the airport in Tivat and Podgorica. Beaches with crystal clear water are in close proximity, and ski resorts are about two hours away by car.
This villa represents a unique opportunity for a luxurious family life, but also for an attractive investment thanks to its great potential for renting out.

listing.description:
EKSKLUZIVAN JEDNOSOBAN APARTMAN U TIVTU – 45,20 m²
Predstavljamo elegantan jednosoban apartman u modernom klupskom kompleksu u Tivtu, koji se sastoji od svega 10 savremenih butik zgrada, pažljivo raspoređenih oko uređenih zelenih površina, sa podzemnim parkingom i ograđenom, bezbednom teritorijom. Kompleks je pozicioniran u drugom redu od Jadranske magistrale, što omogućava jednostavan pristup svim sadržajima bez strmih uspona i uz znatno više mira i privatnosti.
Apartman se nalazi u prizemlju i ima 45,20 m², odnosno 47,57 m² obračunske površine, jednu spavaću sobu, privatnu terasu i dvorište. Arhitektura je savremena, sa pažljivo odabranim prirodnim materijalima i mediteranskim pejzažnim uređenjem koje uključuje masline i dekorativno rastinje.
Stanovnicima su na raspolaganju bazen sa ležaljkama, dečje igralište, sportska zona, prostor za vežbanje na otvorenom, zona za roštilj i druženje, kao i uređena zajednička „komšijska dnevna soba“ na otvorenom. Posebna pažnja posvećena je privatnosti i bezbednosti, uz ograđen kompleks, video nadzor 24/7 i savremenu rasvetu duž celog perimetra.
Lokacija omogućava da su centar Tivta, plaža, Porto Montenegro, restorani i prodavnice dostupni pešaka, dok su međunarodne škole, vrtići, žičara za Lovćen i Aerodrom Tivat udaljeni približno 10 minuta vožnje.
Cena: 432.879 €
Planirani završetak radova je 2027. godine. Ova rezidencija predstavlja odličan izbor za stalni život, odmor ili investiciju, uz spoj urbanog komfora, prirodnog okruženja i sadržaja modernog privatnog naselja.

EXCLUSIVE ONE-BEDROOM APARTMENT IN TIVAT – 45,20 m²
We present an elegant one-bedroom apartment in a modern club complex in Tivat, consisting of only 10 modern boutique buildings, carefully arranged around landscaped green areas, with underground parking and a fenced, secure territory. The complex is positioned in the second row from Jadranska magistrala, which allows easy access to all amenities without steep ascents and with significantly more peace and privacy.
The apartment is located on the ground floor and has 45,20 m², or 47,57 m² of calculated area, one bedroom, a private terrace and a courtyard. The architecture is modern, with carefully selected natural materials and Mediterranean landscape design that includes olive trees and decorative plants.
Residents have access to a swimming pool with sun loungers, a children's playground, a sports zone, an outdoor exercise area, a barbecue and socializing zone, as well as a landscaped common "neighborhood living room" outdoors. Special attention is paid to privacy and security, with a fenced complex, 24/7 video surveillance and modern lighting along the entire perimeter.
The location allows that Tivat center, beach, Porto Montenegro, restaurants and shops are accessible on foot, while international schools, kindergartens, the cable car to Lovćen and Tivat Airport are approximately 10 minutes' drive away.
Price: 432.879 €
The planned completion of works is 2027. This residence represents an excellent choice for permanent living, vacation or investment, combining urban comfort, a natural environment and the amenities of a modern private settlement.

listing.title: Prodaja, dvosoban stan, 70m², Marići, Tivat

listing.description:
DVOSOBAN APARTMAN SA DVE TERASE I PRIVATNIM DVORIŠTEM – TIVAT
Predstavljamo prostran dvosoban apartman u pažljivo projektovanom klupskom kompleksu u Tivtu, koji se sastoji od samo 10 modernih butik zgrada i nudi spoj privatnosti, zelenila i sadržaja koji podsećaju na savremeni privatni resort. Kompleks se nalazi u drugom redu od Jadranske magistrale, što omogućava mirnije okruženje i jednostavan pristup centru Tivta, plaži i Porto Montenegru.
Apartman se nalazi u prizemlju i nudi 66,74 m², odnosno 70,74 m² obračunske površine, dve spavaće sobe, dve terase, privatno dvorište i pogled na baštu i planinu. Uređeno mediteransko zelenilo, masline i dekorativno rastinje dodatno naglašavaju osećaj privatnosti.
Stanari imaju pristup bazenu, dečjem igralištu, sportskoj zoni, prostoru za vežbanje na otvorenom, zoni za roštilj i druženje, kao i zajedničkom prostoru za opuštanje na otvorenom. Podzemni parking, ograđena teritorija, video nadzor 24/7 i savremena rasveta pružaju dodatnu sigurnost i komfor.
Centar grada, plaža, Porto Montenegro, restorani i prodavnice nalaze se na pešačkoj udaljenosti, dok su međunarodne škole, vrtići, medicinske ustanove, tržni centri, žičara za Lovćen i Aerodrom Tivat udaljeni približno 10 minuta vožnje.

TWO-BEDROOM APARTMENT WITH TWO TERRACES AND A PRIVATE COURTYARD – TIVAT
We present a spacious two-bedroom apartment in a carefully designed club complex in Tivat, which consists of only 10 modern boutique buildings and offers a combination of privacy, greenery, and amenities reminiscent of a contemporary private resort. The complex is located in the second row from Jadranska magistrala, which provides a quieter environment and easy access to the center of Tivat, the beach, and Porto Montenegro.
The apartment is located on the ground floor and offers 66.74 m², or 70.74 m² of calculated area, two bedrooms, two terraces, a private courtyard, and a garden and mountain view. Landscaped Mediterranean greenery, olive trees, and ornamental plants further emphasize the sense of privacy.
Residents have access to a swimming pool, a children's playground, a sports zone, an outdoor exercise area, a barbecue and socializing zone, as well as a communal outdoor relaxation area. Underground parking, a fenced territory, 24/7 video surveillance, and modern lighting provide additional security and comfort.

listing.description:
LUKSUZNI PENTHOUSE SA KROVNOM TERASOM – TIVAT
Jedna od najatraktivnijih dostupnih rezidencija je ekskluzivni penthouse u modernom klupskom kompleksu u Tivtu, koji čini svega 10 savremenih butik zgrada, okruženih pažljivo uređenim zelenim površinama. Koncept kompleksa pruža privatnost i osećaj ekskluzivnog rezidencijalnog naselja, uz bogate sadržaje poput bazena, sportskih zona, dečjeg igrališta i uređenih prostora za druženje.
Penthouse se nalazi na drugom spratu i ima 84,90 m², odnosno 89,05 m² obračunske površine, jednu spavaću sobu, prostranu terasu, privatnu krovnu terasu i baštu, uz pogled na more, planine i uređeno zelenilo. Velike spoljne površine predstavljaju jednu od najvećih prednosti ove jedinice i omogućavaju potpuno uživanje u mediteranskom načinu života.
Kompleks je smešten u drugom redu od Jadranske magistrale, bez strmih uspona i sa jednostavnim pristupom glavnim gradskim pravcima. Porto Montenegro, plaža, centar Tivta, restorani i prodavnice nalaze se na pešačkoj udaljenosti, dok su međunarodne škole, vrtići, žičara za Lovćen i Aerodrom Tivat udaljeni oko 10 minuta vožnje.
Dodatnu vrednost čine podzemni parking, ograđena i bezbedna teritorija, video nadzor 24/7, pažljivo uređeni pejzaž i sadržaji namenjeni isključivo kvalitetu života stanara.

Planirani završetak radova je 2027. godine. Penthouse predstavlja izuzetnu priliku za kupce koji traže prostranu i privatnu premium rezidenciju sa velikim spoljnim površinama, u neposrednoj blizini Porto Montenegra i svih ključnih sadržaja Tivta.

LUXURY PENTHOUSE WITH ROOF TERRACE – TIVAT
One of the most attractive available residences is an exclusive penthouse in a modern club complex in Tivat, which consists of only 10 modern boutique buildings, surrounded by carefully landscaped green areas. The concept of the complex provides privacy and a sense of an exclusive residential settlement, with rich amenities such as a swimming pool, sports zones, a children's playground, and landscaped areas for socializing.
The penthouse is located on the second floor and has 84.90 m², or 89.05 m² of calculated area, one bedroom, a spacious terrace, a private roof terrace and garden, with views of the sea, mountains, and landscaped greenery. Large outdoor areas represent one of the biggest advantages of this unit and allow for complete enjoyment of the Mediterranean lifestyle.
The complex is located in the second row from the Adriatic highway, without steep ascents and with easy access to the main city routes. Porto Montenegro, the beach, Tivat center, restaurants and shops are within walking distance, while international schools, kindergartens, the Lovćen cable car, and Tivat Airport are about a 10-minute drive away.
Additional value is provided by underground parking, a fenced and secure territory, 24/7 video surveillance, a carefully landscaped environment and amenities intended exclusively for the quality of life of residents.

The planned completion of works is 2027. The penthouse represents an exceptional opportunity for buyers looking for a spacious and private premium residence with large outdoor areas, in the immediate vicinity of Porto Montenegro and all key amenities of Tivat.

listing.title: Prodaja, garsonjera, 54m², Sveti Stefan, Budva
Sale, studio apartment, 54m², Sveti Stefan, Budva
listing.description:
Luksuzni studio apartman sa terasom – 298.100 €
Ekskluzivni studio apartman smješten je na jednoj od najatraktivnijih lokacija crnogorskog primorja, između Budve i Svetog Stefana, u okruženju mediteranskog rastinja, maslinjaka i parka Miločer. U okviru privatnog kompleksa površine 10.000 m², ova nekretnina pruža spoj udobnosti, privatnosti i savremenog luksuza.
Apartman raspolaže unutrašnjom površinom od 46,4 m², uz dodatnu terasu od 7,8 m², što čini ukupnu površinu od 54,2 m². Funkcionalan raspored omogućava optimalno korišćenje prostora, dok se mediteranski stil enterijera, prirodni materijali i pažljivo odabrani detalji uklapaju u ambijent luksuznog odmora.

Located in one of the most desirable locations on the Adriatic, these residences combine contemporary architecture, carefully designed living spaces, and premium amenities, creating an environment where comfort, aesthetics, and the Mediterranean way of life naturally intertwine.

listing.title: Stambeni kompleks u Lastvi Grbaljskoj br. 2452
Residential Complex in Lastva Grbaljska
listing.description:
Moderan stambeni kompleks u Budvi pored plaže Jaz
Novi stambeni projekat, smešten u zelenom delu Budve, u podnožju brda Budvanska Lastva. Kompleks uspešno spaja prirodni mir sa blizinom glavnih gradskih i turističkih sadržaja. Samo nekoliko minuta vožnje deli ga od centra Budve, Starog grada, marine, prodavnica, restorana, kao i čuvene plaže Jaz — jedne od najpopularnijih na čitavoj obali Crne Gore.
Projekat se sastoji od šest zasebnih stambenih zgrada, izvedenih u savremenom arhitektonskom stilu sa elementima mediteranske estetike. Korišćeni su visokokvalitetni fasadni materijali, uključujući prirodni kamen, drvo i energetski efikasne tehnologije. Zgrade su projektovane u niskogradnom formatu: sa podzemnim garažama, prizemljem i dva puna nivoa.
Kompleks je deo velikog stambenog i infrastrukturnog projekta, u koji ulaze vile, sportski tereni, zone za odmor, stambeni i komercijalni objekti. Kompleks zauzima centralno mesto u ovoj koncepciji, što ga čini posebno atraktivnim kako za život, tako i za ulaganje.
Stanovi u kompleksu projektovani su sa maksimalnom pažnjom prema komforu. Prostrane terase, funkcionalni rasporedi, velika količina prirodne svetlosti, kvalitetna termo- i zvučna izolacija, savremeni sistemi grejanja i hlađenja — sve to obezbeđuje visok nivo života tokom cele godine.
Trenutno su u prodaji dostupni različiti tipovi stanovanja: kompaktni studiji površine 29 m², 34 m² i 39 m², udobni stanovi sa jednom spavaćom sobom površine 52 m², kao i prostrani apartmani sa dve spavaće sobe površine 88 m². Svi stanovi imaju direktan ili delimičan pogled na more i okolna brda.
Na teritoriji kompleksa biće uređene zone za odmor, zelenilo i parking. Sva neophodna gradska i turistička infrastruktura nalazi se na pešačkoj udaljenosti, a pogodna lokacija čini ovaj kompleks idealnim izborom kako za lično stanovanje, tako i za investicije.
Završetak radova i puštanje objekta u upotrebu planirani su za 1. jul 2027. godine.

Modern residential complex in Kotor
A new residential project located in the green part Kotor. The complex successfully combines natural tranquility with proximity to the main urban and tourist attractions.
The project consists of six separate residential buildings designed in a modern architectural style with elements of Mediterranean aesthetics. High-quality facade materials are used, including natural stone, wood, and energy-efficient technologies. The buildings are designed in a low-rise format: with underground garages, a ground floor, and two full levels.
The complex is part of a large-scale residential and infrastructure project that includes villas, sports grounds, recreation areas, residential and commercial properties. The complex occupies a central place in this concept, which makes it especially attractive both for living and for investment.
The apartments in the complex are designed with maximum attention to comfort. Spacious terraces, well-planned layouts, plenty of natural light, high-quality thermal and sound insulation, modern heating and cooling systems — all this ensures a high standard of living all year round.
At present, various types of housing are available for sale: compact studios of 24 m2. New projects C and D 29-65m2, end of building october 2027. All apartments have direct or partial sea views and views of the surrounding hills.
The complex will feature recreation areas, greenery, and parking. All necessary urban and resort infrastructure is within walking distance, and the convenient location makes this complex an ideal choice both for personal residence and for investment.
The completion date is scheduled for Oct 1, 2027.

Najekskluzivnija kolekcija taunhausa u okviru luksuzne zajednice Luštica Bay. Smješteni na uzvišenju iznad Jadranskog mora i šampionksog golf terena Gary Player Design, taunhausovi stvaraju novi format coastal golf living u Crnoj Gori – kombinaciju privatnosti vile, arhitekture na nivou resort residences i infrastrukture svjetske klase.

Svaki taunhaus je dizajniran po konceptu „život unutar i izvan kuće kao jedinstven prostor“ – dnevne zone se neprimjetno prelivaju u prostrane terase, privatne bašte, lounge zone i bazene. Rasporedi odvajaju javne i privatne prostore na dva nivoa, stvarajući osjećaj odvojene vile sa maksimalnim komforom i privatnošću. U mnogim rezidencijama predviđene su dnevne sobe sa dvostrukim svjetlom, kamini, master spavaće sobe sa izlazom na panoramske terase, tehničke prostorije i prostrane zone za odlaganje.

Prvi stambeni golf kompleks u Crnoj Gori i jedini projekat ovog nivoa u regionu. Centralni dio područja biće prvo 18-rupno šampionkso golf teren u zemlji, razvijeno od strane legendarne kompanije Gary Player Design. Posebnost terena ogleda se u tome što se sa gotovo svake rupe pružaju panoramski pogledi na Jadransko more i Boku Kotorsku – što čini dijelom rijetke kategorije golf zajednica sa morskim pogledima svjetskog nivoa.

The complex - Townhouses
The most exclusive collection of townhouses within the luxury community of Luštica Bay. Perched on an elevation above the Adriatic Sea and the championship Gary Player Design golf course, the complex townhouses create a new format of coastal golf living in Montenegro — a blend of villa privacy, resort-level architecture, and world-class infrastructure.
Available options:
• 3-bedroom townhouses • Area: 184–186 m² • Price: €2,524,000 – €2,643,000
All townhouses are offered at the construction stage, with completion scheduled for December 2028.
Each townhouse is designed with the concept of "indoor and outdoor living as one space" — living areas flow seamlessly into spacious terraces, private gardens, lounge zones, and pools. The layouts separate public and private spaces across two levels, creating the feel of a standalone villa with maximum comfort and privacy. Many residences feature double-height living rooms, fireplaces, master bedrooms with access to panoramic terraces, utility rooms, and ample storage areas.
Townhouse features:
• panoramic views of the sea and golf course • private pools • landscaped gardens and green courtyards • summer kitchens and open dining areas • spacious stone terraces • open-plan living and dining areas • fireplaces in living rooms • panoramic glazing • natural premium materials • designer kitchens by Nolte or similar premium level • Miele appliances • heated floors in bathrooms • air conditioning systems with wind protection • private parking spaces • electric vehicle charging • utility rooms and storage areas • Mediterranean-style architecture • high privacy of residences • location near the golf clubhouse and wellness center
The first residential golf complex in Montenegro and the only project of this caliber in the region. The centerpiece of the area will be the country's first 18-hole championship golf course, designed by the legendary Gary Player Design. The course's unique feature is that nearly every hole offers panoramic views of the Adriatic Sea and the Bay of Kotor — making the complex part of a rare category of golf communities with world-class sea views.
Townhouse owners receive full access to all Luštica Bay infrastructure:

Nudimo na prodaju apartmane sa 1 ili 2 spavaće sobe u modernom stambenom kompleksu u Tivtu, koji se nalazi u mirnom delu grada u blizini centra, aerodroma i marine za jahte Porto Montenegro. Projekat kombinuje pogodnu lokaciju, modernu arhitekturu i ograničen broj stanova, što ga čini atraktivnim kako za sopstveni boravak, tako i za investiciju.
Osnovne karakteristike tipskih stanova:
• Površina: 42.93–76.16 m² • Spavaće sobe: 1–2 • Kupatila: 1 • Spratovi: 0-2 • Parking mesto uključeno u cenu
O stanu:
U zavisnosti od rasporeda, stanovi uključuju prostrani dnevni boravak sa kuhinjom i trpezarijom, jednu ili dve spavaće sobe, kupatilo i terasu. Stanovi u prizemlju dodatno poseduju sopstvena dvorišta, što stvara dodatni prostor za odmor na otvorenom.
Veliki prozori obezbeđuju dobro prirodno osvetljenje prostorija, a promišljena organizacija prostora čini stanove udobnim kako za stalni boravak, tako i za odmor pored mora.
Infrastruktura kompleksa:
• Zatvorena teritorija • Pejzažno uređenje • Podzemni i nadzemni parking • Liftovi • Sistem video nadzora • Kontrola pristupa • Uređena unutrašnja dvorišta • Pešačke zone za odmor • Moderni inženjerski sistemi
Lokacija:
• Aerodrom Tivat — oko 2 km • Centar Tivta — oko 3 km • Porto Montenegro — oko 3 km • Plaže i šetalište — nekoliko minuta vožnje automobilom • Kotor — oko 10 km • Budva — oko 20 km
Investicioni potencijal:
Tivat ostaje jedno od najtraženijih tržišta nekretnina u Crnoj Gori zahvaljujući razvoju Porto Montenegra, modernoj infrastrukturi i visokoj potražnji za iznajmljivanjem. Stanovi sa jednom i dve spavaće sobe uživaju najveću potražnju među zakupcima i kupcima, što obezbeđuje visoku likvidnost objekta i stabilan potencijal za izdavanje.
Planirani rok završetka izgradnje — sredina 2027. godine.

photos/renders of a typical apartment in the project
We offer for sale 1 or 2-bedroom apartments in a modern residential complex in Tivat, located in a quiet area of the city near the center, the airport, and the Porto Montenegro yacht marina. The project combines a convenient location, modern architecture, and a limited number of apartments, making it attractive both for personal residence and for investment.
Main characteristics of typical apartments:
• Area: 42.93–76.16 m² • Bedrooms: 1–2 • Bathrooms: 1 • Floors: 0-2 • Parking space included in the price
About the apartment:
Depending on the layout, the apartments include a spacious living room with a kitchen and dining area, one or two bedrooms, a bathroom, and a terrace. Ground-floor apartments additionally feature private courtyards, creating extra space for outdoor relaxation.
Large windows provide good natural lighting, and the well-thought-out organization of space makes the apartments comfortable for both permanent residence and seaside vacations.
Complex infrastructure:
• Gated territory • Landscaped grounds • Underground and surface parking • Elevators • Video surveillance system • Access control • Well-maintained courtyards • Pedestrian recreation areas • Modern engineering systems
Location:
• Tivat Airport — approx. 2 km • Tivat center — approx. 3 km • Porto Montenegro — approx. 3 km • Beaches and promenade — a few minutes by car • Kotor — approx. 10 km • Budva — approx. 20 km
Investment potential:
Tivat remains one of the most sought-after real estate markets in Montenegro due to the development of Porto Montenegro, modern infrastructure, and high rental demand. One and two-bedroom apartments are in the highest demand among tenants and buyers, ensuring high liquidity of the property and stable rental potential.
Planned completion date — mid-2027.

listing.title: Apartmani u Kolašinu br. 2748
Apartments in Kolasin
listing.description:
Nudimo na prodaju hotelske sobe u premijum kompleksu kojim upravlja međunarodni brend, smeštenom u centru Kolašina. Projekat kombinuje prednosti profesionalnog hotelskog upravljanja, razvijene odmarališne infrastrukture i jedne od najperspektivnijih planinskih lokacija u Crnoj Gori.
Osnovne karakteristike tipskih soba:
• Površina: 28,19–36,57 m² • Kupatilo: 1 • Format: hotelska soba • Profesionalno hotelsko upravljanje • Mogućnost učešća u programu prihoda od izdavanja
O sobi:
Sobe su dizajnirane u modernom hotelskom formatu sa akcentom na udobnost i funkcionalnost. Rasporedi predviđaju prostor za spavanje, kupatilo i mesta za odlaganje stvari. Panoramsko zastakljivanje obezbeđuje dobro prirodno osvetljenje i pruža pogled na planine ili gradski deo Kolašina.
Enterijeri su urađeni u modernom stilu uz korišćenje prirodnih materijala i kvalitetne završne obrade, u skladu sa standardima međunarodnog hotelskog brenda.
Infrastruktura:
• Recepcija • Lobi bar • Restoran • SPA centar • Fitnes sala • Panoramski bazen • Room Service • Butici • Parking • Usluge konsijerža i hotelskog servisa
Lokacija:
• Centralni trg Kolašina — oko 100 m • Restorani, prodavnice i gradska infrastruktura — na pešačkoj udaljenosti • Ski centar Kolašin 1450 — oko 11 km • Ski centar Kolašin 1600 — oko 13 km • Aerodrom Podgorica — oko 60 km
Investicioni potencijal:
Nekretnine u Kolašinu ostaju jedan od najbrže rastućih segmenata tržišta u Crnoj Gori zahvaljujući razvoju ski infrastrukture i celogodišnjeg turizma. Format hotelske sobe pod upravom međunarodnog operatera omogućava vlasnicima da ostvaruju prihod od izdavanja bez potrebe za samostalnim upravljanjem objektom, uz zadržavanje mogućnosti ličnog korišćenja u određenim periodima.

We offer hotel rooms for sale in a premium complex managed by an international brand, located in the center of Kolašin. The project combines the advantages of professional hotel management, developed resort infrastructure, and one of the most promising mountain locations in Montenegro.
Key features of standard rooms:
• Area: 28.19–36.57 m² • Bathroom: 1 • Format: hotel room • Professional hotel management • Opportunity to participate in a rental income program
About the room:
The rooms are designed in a modern hotel format with an emphasis on comfort and functionality. The layouts include a sleeping area, a bathroom, and storage space. Panoramic glazing provides good natural light and offers views of the mountains or the urban part of Kolašin.
Interiors are executed in a modern style using natural materials and high-quality finishes that meet the standards of an international hotel brand.
Infrastructure:
• Reception • Lobby bar • Restaurant • SPA center • Fitness room • Panoramic pool • Room Service • Boutiques • Parking • Concierge and hotel services
Location:
• Kolašin central square — about 100 m • Restaurants, shops, and city infrastructure — within walking distance • Kolašin 1450 Ski Center — about 11 km • Kolašin 1600 Ski Center — about 13 km • Podgorica Airport — about 60 km
Investment potential:
Real estate in Kolašin remains one of the fastest-growing market segments in Montenegro due to the development of ski infrastructure and year-round tourism. The hotel room format managed by an international operator allows owners to receive rental income without the need for self-management of the property, while maintaining the possibility of personal use during established periods.

listing.title: Stan u Kolašinu br. 2752
Apartment in Kolasin
listing.description:
Nudimo na prodaju apartmane u modernom hotelsko-rezidencijalnom kompleksu kojim upravlja međunarodni brend. Projekat se nalazi u samom centru Kolašina i kombinuje visok nivo usluge, razvijenu infrastrukturu i investicioni potencijal jednog od najbrže rastućih planinskih odmarališta u Crnoj Gori.
Osnovne karakteristike:
• Površina: 50,93 m² • Kupatilo: 1 • Sprat: 4 • Format: apartmani
O apartmanima:
Raspored uključuje prostranu spavaću sobu, odvojenu dnevnu zonu sa mekim nameštajem, kupatilo i predsoblje. Zahvaljujući povećanoj površini u poređenju sa standardnim hotelskim sobama, apartmani pružaju viši nivo komfora kako za lični odmor, tako i za duži boravak.
Veliko panoramsko zastakljivanje ispunjava prostor prirodnom svetlošću i stvara osećaj otvorenosti. Raspored omogućava udobno smeštanje kompletne zone za spavanje i odvojenog prostora za odmor i prijem gostiju.
Enterijeri su urađeni u modernom stilu uz korišćenje prirodnih materijala, kvalitetne završne obrade i opreme koja odgovara standardima međunarodnog hotelskog operatera.
Infrastruktura kompleksa:
• Recepcija i 24-časovna usluga • Lobi bar • Restoran • SPA centar • Fitnes sala • Panoramski bazen • Room Service • Butici i komercijalni prostori • Parking • Konsijerž servis • Profesionalno hotelsko upravljanje
Lokacija:
• Centralni trg Kolašina — oko 100 m • Prodavnice, restorani i gradska infrastruktura — na pešačkoj udaljenosti • Ski centar Kolašin 1450 — oko 11 km • Ski centar Kolašin 1600 — oko 13 km • Nacionalni park Biogradska gora — oko 20 km • Aerodrom Podgorica — oko 60 km
Investicioni potencijal:
Kolašin je jedan od ključnih centara razvoja planinskog turizma u Crnoj Gori. Aktivni razvoj ski infrastrukture, celogodišnji turistički promet i ograničena ponuda kvalitetnih nekretnina stvaraju visoku potražnju za objektima ovakvog formata. Apartmani u kompleksu kojim upravlja međunarodni brend omogućavaju vlasniku da kombinuje lično korišćenje nekretnine sa mogućnošću ostvarivanja prihoda od izdavanja putem profesionalne kompanije za upravljanje.

We offer for sale apartments in a modern hotel and residential complex managed by an international brand. The project is located in the very center of Kolašin and combines a high level of service, developed infrastructure, and the investment potential of one of the fastest-growing mountain resorts in Montenegro.
Key features:
• Area: 50.93 m² • Bathroom: 1 • Floor: 4 • Format: apartments
About the apartments:
The layout includes a spacious bedroom, a separate living area with upholstered furniture, a bathroom, and an entrance hall. Due to the increased area compared to standard hotel rooms, the apartments provide a higher level of comfort both for personal vacations and for long-term stays.
Large panoramic glazing fills the space with natural light and creates a feeling of openness. The layout allows for the comfortable placement of a full-fledged sleeping area and a separate space for relaxation and receiving guests.
The interiors are designed in a modern style using natural materials, high-quality finishes, and equipment that meets the standards of an international hotel operator.
Complex infrastructure:
• Reception and 24/7 service • Lobby bar • Restaurant • SPA center • Fitness room • Panoramic pool • Room Service • Boutiques and commercial premises • Parking • Concierge service • Professional hotel management
Location:
• Kolašin central square — about 100 m • Shops, restaurants, and city infrastructure — within walking distance • Kolašin 1450 Ski Center — about 11 km • Kolašin 1600 Ski Center — about 13 km • Biogradska Gora National Park — about 20 km • Podgorica Airport — about 60 km
Investment potential:
Kolašin is one of the key centers for the development of mountain tourism in Montenegro. The active development of ski infrastructure, year-round tourist flow, and limited supply of quality real estate create high demand for properties of this format. Apartments in a complex managed by an international brand allow the owner to combine personal use of the property with the possibility of generating rental income through a professional management company.

listing.title: Stan u Kolašinu br. 2753
Apartment in Kolasin
listing.description:
Nudimo na prodaju apartman sa 1 spavaćom sobom u modernom kondo-hotelu u centru Kolašina. Objekat kombinuje mogućnost ličnog korišćenja, profesionalno hotelsko upravljanje i investicioni potencijal jednog od najbrže rastućih planinskih odmarališta u Crnoj Gori.
Osnovne karakteristike:
• Površina: 40,53 m² • Spavaće sobe: 1 • Kupatilo: 1 • Sprat: 4 • Format: apartman sa odvojenom spavaćom sobom
O apartmanu:
Raspored uključuje odvojenu spavaću sobu, dnevni boravak, kupatilo i prostranu terasu. Zahvaljujući poziciji na četvrtom spratu i ugaonoj konfiguraciji, apartman se odlikuje dobrom osunčanošću i povećanom površinom zastakljenja.
Spavaća zona je odvojena od dnevnog boravka, što objekat čini udobnijim za duži boravak u poređenju sa standardnim hotelskim sobama. Prostor je dizajniran u modernom planinskom stilu sa akcentom na prirodne materijale, tople teksture i funkcionalnost.
Apartman je deo hotelskog kompleksa međunarodnog nivoa i može se koristiti kako za sopstveni odmor, tako i za ostvarivanje prihoda od izdavanja kroz profesionalno upravljanje.
Infrastruktura kompleksa:
• Recepcija • Lobi bar • Restoran • SPA centar • Fitnes sala • Panoramski bazen • Room Service • Butici • Parking • Transfer do ski centara • Profesionalno hotelsko upravljanje
Lokacija:
• Centar Kolašina • Glavni gradski trg — oko 100 m • Restorani, kafići i prodavnice — na pešačkoj udaljenosti • Ski centar Kolašin 1450 — oko 11 km • Ski centar Kolašin 1600 — oko 13 km • Aerodrom Podgorica — oko 60 km
Investicioni potencijal:
Kolašin ostaje jedna od najdinamičnije razvijajućih turističkih destinacija u Crnoj Gori zahvaljujući razvoju ski infrastrukture i celogodišnjeg turizma. Apartmani sa odvojenom spavaćom sobom uživaju stabilnu potražnju među gostima odmarališta, a format kondo-hotela omogućava kombinovanje ličnog korišćenja nekretnine sa ostvarivanjem prihoda od izdavanja pod upravom međunarodnog hotelskog operatera. Projekat predviđa garantovanu profitabilnost i profesionalno upravljanje, što objekat čini atraktivnim kako za investitore, tako i za kupce koji traže sopstvenu nekretninu na planini.

We offer for sale a 1-bedroom apartment in a modern condo-hotel in the center of Kolašin. The property combines the opportunity for personal use, professional hotel management, and the investment potential of one of Montenegro's fastest-growing mountain resorts.
Key features:
• Area: 40.53 m² • Bedrooms: 1 • Bathroom: 1 • Floor: 4 • Format: apartment with a separate bedroom
About the apartment:
The layout includes a separate bedroom, a living/lounge area, a bathroom, and a spacious terrace. Due to its location on the fourth floor and corner configuration, the apartment features excellent natural light and increased glazing area.
The sleeping area is separated from the living room, making the property more comfortable for long-term stays compared to standard hotel rooms. The space is designed in a modern mountain style with an emphasis on natural materials, warm textures, and functionality.
The apartment is part of an international-level hotel complex and can be used both for personal vacations and for generating rental income through professional management.
Complex infrastructure:
• Reception • Lobby bar • Restaurant • SPA center • Fitness room • Panoramic pool • Room Service • Boutiques • Parking • Shuttle to ski centers • Professional hotel management
Location:
• Center of Kolašin • Main city square — about 100 m • Restaurants, cafes, and shops — within walking distance • Kolašin 1450 ski center — about 11 km • Kolašin 1600 ski center — about 13 km • Podgorica Airport — about 60 km
Investment potential:
Kolašin remains one of the most dynamically developing tourist destinations in Montenegro due to the development of ski infrastructure and year-round tourism. One-bedroom apartments enjoy stable demand among resort guests, and the condo-hotel format allows combining personal use of the property with rental income under the management of an international hotel operator. The project provides for guaranteed returns and professional management, making the property attractive both for investors and for buyers looking for their own real estate in the mountains.

listing.title: Apartman u Luštici br. 2775
Room in Luštica
listing.description:
Nudimo na prodaju brendiranu rezidenciju u okviru hotela sa pet zvezdica The Chedi Luštica Bay — jedne od najprepoznatljivijih hotelskih adresa na crnogorskom primorju, smeštene u centru marine Luštica Bay.
Osnovne karakteristike:
• Površina: 47 m² • Kategorija: Grand Deluxe soba sa pogledom na more • Spavaća soba: 1, predviđena za 2 odrasle osobe i dete • Balkon: sopstveni, sa pogledom na more i marinu • Očekivani godišnji prinos: 4–5%
O sobi:
Soba je uređena u svetloj, mirnoj paleti boja — terasa keramika na podu, detalji od hrastovine, panoramski prozori od poda do plafona i sopstveni balkon sa pogledom na more i jahte u marini. Soba poseduje mini-kuhinju, kadu i tuš sa kišnim efektom, Wi-Fi i kompletan set hotelskih pogodnosti.
O kompleksu:
The Chedi Luštica Bay — hotel sa pet zvezdica u centru marine Luštica Bay, na poluostrvu Luštica, u blizini Tivta. Na teritoriji se nalaze otvoreni i zatvoreni bazeni, spa centar, restorani, barovi, sopstvena plaža i razvijena infrastruktura marine sa jahtama, restoranima i prodavnicama.
Lokacija:
• Marina Luštica Bay — na teritoriji kompleksa • Svetionik i šetalište — na pešačkoj udaljenosti • Tivat — na nekoliko minuta vožnje
Investicioni potencijal:
Soba učestvuje u programu iznajmljivanja kojim upravlja hotel, što kupovinu pretvara u gotov aktiv koji ne zahteva samostalno upravljanje, sa očekivanim prinosom od 4–5% godišnje. Format brendirane rezidencije pri hotelu sa pet zvezdica u jednom od najtraženijih projekata na crnogorskom primorju kombinuje investicionu komponentu sa mogućnošću ličnog korišćenja sobe.

We offer for sale a branded residence within the five-star The Chedi Luštica Bay hotel — one of the most recognizable hotel addresses on the Montenegrin coast, located in the heart of the Luštica Bay marina.
Key features:
• Area: 47 m² • Category: Grand Deluxe Room with a sea view • Bedroom: 1, designed for 2 adults and a child • Balcony: private, with a view of the sea and the marina • Expected annual yield: 4–5%
About the room:
The room is designed in a light, calm color palette — terrazzo ceramic flooring, oak details, floor-to-ceiling panoramic windows, and a private balcony with views of the sea and the yachts in the marina. The room features a kitchenette, a bathtub and a rain shower, Wi-Fi, and a full range of hotel amenities.
About the complex:
The Chedi Luštica Bay is a five-star hotel in the center of the Luštica Bay marina, on the Luštica peninsula, near Tivat. The premises include indoor and outdoor pools, a spa center, restaurants, bars, a private beach, and the developed infrastructure of the marina with yachts, restaurants, and shops.
Location:
• Luštica Bay Marina — on the territory of the complex • Lighthouse and promenade — within walking distance • Tivat — a few minutes' drive away
Investment potential:
The room participates in a hotel-managed rental program, which turns the purchase into a turnkey asset that requires no self-administration, with an expected yield of 4–5% per year. The branded residence format at a five-star hotel in one of the most sought-after projects on the Montenegrin coast combines an investment component with the possibility of personal use of the room.

listing.title: Taunhaus u Kavaču br. 2777
Townhouse in Kavac
listing.description:
Nudimo na prodaju taunhaus sa 3 spavaće sobe u modernom stambenom kompleksu, smještenom na mirnoj padini između Kotora i aerodroma Tivat. Kuća je potpuno spremna za useljenje i dostupna za kupovinu po sistemu „ključ u ruke“. Kompleks spaja privatnost seoske kuće, sopstvenu parcelu i mediteransku arhitekturu od vrhunskih ekoloških materijala.
Osnovne karakteristike:
• Spavaće sobe: 3 • Kupatila: 2 (uključujući gostinjsko) • Broj spratova: 2 • Ukupna površina kuće: 110.3 m² • Površina parcele: 200 m² • Terase: 2, proširena terasa na drugom spratu — sa pogledom na more • Sopstvena garaža
O taunhausu:
Raspored kuće predviđa na prvom spratu prostrani dnevni boravak sa kuhinjom i trpezarijom, gostinjsko kupatilo, predsoblje i terasu (15 m²) sa izlazom na plac.
Na drugom spratu se nalaze dvije spavaće sobe, dodatna prostorija koja se može koristiti kao treća spavaća soba, radna soba ili garderober, kupatilo, hodnik i proširena terasa (10.72 m²) sa otvorenim pogledom na more.
Kuća je izgrađena po modernim tehnologijama od energetski efikasnih materijala u mediteranskom stilu. Panoramski prozori otporni na udarce obezbjeđuju dobro prirodno osvjetljenje i vizuelno spajaju unutrašnji prostor sa prirodom koja ga okružuje.
U cijenu je uključeno:
• unutrašnja završna obrada: parket/keramičke pločice, okrečeni zidovi i plafoni (boja po izboru kupca) • potpuno završena fasada, krov, prozori • inženjerske komunikacije: struja, vodosnabdijevanje, kanalizacija, bojleri u kupatilima • klimatizacija u dnevnom boravku i glavnoj spavaćoj sobi • podno grijanje u kupatilima i kuhinji • sanitarije i pločice u kupatilima • terasa ispred kuće, sopstvena garaža, staza do ulaza • plac: osnovno uređenje (travnjak) i živa ograda po obodu
Specijalna ponuda:
Prilikom kupovine taunhausa, investitor obezbjeđuje besplatno profesionalno pejzažno uređenje parcele od strane iskusnog baštovana — u okviru akcije povodom završetka izgradnje svih kuća tipa A u kompleksu.
Dodatne opcije uz doplatu:
• postavljanje dodatnih staza • mogućnost ugradnje bazena, saune i teretane po individualnom projektu • kamena obrada kuće i teritorije • potpuno opremanje namještajem „ključ u ruke“ sa dizajnerom • radovi na drvetu unutar/izvan kuće
Infrastruktura kompleksa:
• zatvorena teritorija • savremena mediteranska arhitektura • energetski efikasna gradnja (monolitni armirano-betonski okvir) • parking zone • fleksibilan izbor rasporeda i opcija po individualnom projektu
Lokacija:
• supermarket i apoteka (Škaljari) — oko 2 km • restoran i kafić (Škaljari) — manje od 1 km • Stari grad Kotor — oko 3 km • međunarodni aerodrom aerodrom Tivat — oko 3 km • Porto Montenegro, Tivat — oko 7 km • Stari grad Budva — oko 16 km
Investicioni potencijal:
Region između Kotora i Tivta ostaje jedan od strateški interesantnih pravaca na tržištu nekretnina Crne Gore zahvaljujući blizini aerodroma, Starog grada Kotora i marine Porto Montenegro, uz očuvanje mirnije, "seoske" atmosfere u poređenju sa gustom gradnjom na obali. Sopstvena parcela, savremena energetski efikasna gradnja, fleksibilnost u izboru rasporeda i završne obrade, kao i mogućnost dodatnog uređenja teritorije (bazen, sauna, teretana) čine taunhaus atraktivnim kako za stalni boravak, tako i za dugoročnu investiciju sa potencijalom rasta vrijednosti.

We offer for sale a 3-bedroom townhouse in a modern residential complex located on a quiet hillside between Kotor and Tivat airport. The house is fully move-in ready and available for purchase on a turnkey basis. The complex combines the privacy of a country house, a private plot of land, and Mediterranean architecture built with premium eco-friendly materials.
Key features:
• Bedrooms: 3 • Bathrooms: 2 (including a guest bathroom) • Number of floors: 2 • Total house area: 110.3 m² • Plot area: 200 m² • Terraces: 2, with an enlarged second-floor terrace featuring a sea view • Private garage
About the townhouse:
The layout of the house includes a spacious living room with a kitchen and dining area, a guest bathroom, an entrance hall, and a terrace (15 m²) with access to the plot on the ground floor.
On the second floor, there are two bedrooms, an additional room that can be used as a third bedroom, office, or walk-in closet, a bathroom, a hallway, and an enlarged terrace (10.72 m²) with an open sea view.
The house is built using modern technologies with energy-efficient materials in a Mediterranean style. Panoramic impact-resistant windows provide excellent natural lighting and visually integrate the interior space with the surrounding nature.
The price includes:
• Interior finishing: parquet/ceramic tiles, painted walls and ceilings (color of the buyer's choice) • Fully completed facade, roof, and windows • Engineering utilities: electricity, water supply, sewage, boilers in bathrooms • Air conditioning in the living room and master bedroom • Underfloor heating in bathrooms and the kitchen • Sanitary ware and tiles in bathrooms • Terrace in front of the house, private garage, and entrance path • Plot: basic landscaping (lawn) and a green hedge around the perimeter
Special offer:
When purchasing the townhouse, the developer provides free professional landscaping of the plot by an experienced gardener — as part of a promotion marking the completion of all Type A houses in the complex.
Additional options for an extra charge:
• Laying of additional paths • Possibility of installing a swimming pool, sauna, and gym according to an individual project • Stone finishing of the house and territory • Full turnkey furnishing with a designer • Woodwork inside/outside the house
Complex infrastructure:
• Gated community • Modern Mediterranean architecture • Energy-efficient construction (monolithic reinforced concrete frame) • Parking areas • Flexible choice of layout and options according to an individual project
Location:
• Supermarket and pharmacy (Škaljari) — about 2 km • Restaurant and cafe (Škaljari) — less than 1 km • Kotor Old Town — about 3 km • Tivat International Airport — about 3 km • Porto Montenegro, Tivat — about 7 km • Budva Old Town — about 16 km
Investment potential:
